eqpack.chapter.oq_ae2.title: Applied Energistics 2
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.acceleration_card.de: These accelerate AE2 machines! I recommend using your first calculation processors on these to speed up your inscribers.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.assembler_matrix.des: This multiblock can replace all of your Molecular Assemblers with their associated Pattern Providers. Prepare a lot of matter balls!

It holds 36 patterns per pattern core, can perform 8 recipes in parallel per craft core, and speed cores are its acceleration cards (you can install no more than 5). It has to be a framed rectangular box with no empty space inside, with the maximum size being 7x7x7 (requiring 5 speed cores, 60 pattern cores, 60 craft cores, 68 frames and 150 walls/glass). This quest asks for a more modest 5x5x5 one, which should be plenty for most uses :D
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.cables.title: Cables
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.cables.description.0: These are the skeleton of your AE2 system, connecting all the parts together! Consider upgrading them to Smart and Dense versions for larger networks.
Pro tip: all cables can be colored. Cables of different color do not connect to one another.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.cable_anchor.title: Cable Anchor
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.cable_anchor.descrip: Sticking these into cables allows you to disconnect what would otherwise be connected.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.certus_quartz.title: Certus Quartz
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.certus_quartz.descri: Unless you got these from villagers, what you have to work with is Budding Certus Quartz Blocks, which you find in the meteor. These work the same as Budding Amethyst, slowly growing Certus Quartz Buds, that turn into Clusters. Clusters can be broken for Certus Quartz Crystals. Fortune works on them!

All versions of these budding blocks, except Flawless, degrade over time until they become Certus Quartz Blocks, and all versions degrade one stage if broken to be moved. There is a quest down the line on how to create more of these.
Flawless Budding Certus Quartz grows clusters forever unless you break it. Do not break it! There are other ways to move it depending on the mods installed:
- AE2 itself provides Spatial IO, which can cut and paste blocks form the world, albeit with a slightly bulky setup.
- Mekanism adds a Cardboard Box, which can move individual blocks. Refer to the Mekanism questline.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.certus_quartz_dust.d: Put a Certus Quartz Crystal into an Inscriber to get this. Alternatively, it drops from Certus Quartz Buds before they are fully grown.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.channels.title: Channels
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.channels.description: An infamous part of AE2 is its channel system. You can only connect so much with a simple cable before you run out of channels.
Controllers §oprovide§r channels: 32 from every side of the block. Controllerless networks are limited to 8 channels per network.
Cables §otransfer§r channels: standard cables have a throughput of 8 channels, while dense ones support all 32.
Buses, pattern providers and other network parts §orequire§r one channel each to run. To have this channel, a line of cables must transfer it all the way from a controller face.
The command /ae2 channelmode can change channel settings to multiply the amount of channels cables fit (x2, x3, x4) or turn the system off completely (/ae2 channelmode infinite)
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.charged_certus_quart: Put a Certus Quartz Crystal into a Charger to get this.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.circuit_slicer.title: Circuit Slicer
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.circuit_slicer.descr: This machine can do all Inscriber Press recipes and processes blocks at a time! With this and a Crystal Assembler you officially don't need inscribers anymore :D
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.color_applicator.des: This nifty tool can color cables placed in the world! To work, it needs to be filled with Paint Balls, which are crafted from Matter Balls. The easiest way to do that is with an ME Chest.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.concurrent_processor: Needed to craft some of the more advanced machines in the mod :D
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.controller.title: Controller
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.controller.descripti: The heart of your AE2 system. You can make these into a multiblock if you need more channels than a single controller can provide; the only rules are:
- All controller blocks must be connected;
- No controller block should touch four others in a cross shape;
- The multiblock must fit inside a 7x7x7 cube.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.crafting_card.title: Crafting Card
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.crafting_card.descri: These make Interfaces and Export Buses request autocrafting of the items they need if there are none in stock.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.crafting_cpu.title: Crafting CPU
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.crafting_cpu.descrip: Crafting CPUs are multiblocks that oversee autocrafting; you can't autocraft anything without one on your system. They are composed of Crafting Storage and Crafting Co-Processing Units, and must be built in the shape of a solid box.

Crafting Storage blocks provide temporary storage for the items for the duration of crafting; you can't craft a recipe that requires two thousand items on a CPU with only 1k crafting storage. Crafting Co-Processing Units provide additional threads to the CPU,allowing the process to use more than one machine at the same time.
Every Crafting CPU can only process one crafting request at a time. If you want to craft more things simultaneously, build more CPUs.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.crank.title: Crank
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.crank.description.0: The crank provides a small amount of energy to machines while you hold right click on it. An early game solution, e.e., to charge your Meteorite Compass.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.creating_your_own_bu: Throw Charged Certus Quartz into water together with a Certus Quartz Block to get your own budding blocks. Throwing it back with more charged certus upgrades the stage of the block. You can't get Flawless this way, though :(
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.crystal_assembler.de: This machine can make processors of all kinds from printed circuits at a much faster rate than the Inscriber, but it also opens the floodgates for crafting every other machine in Extended AE.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.crystal_fixer.title: Crystal Fixer
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.crystal_fixer.descri: This machine requires Charged Certus Quartz Crystals and energy to fix Budding Certus Quartz blocks! It even has a 5%% chance to upgrade a Flawed one into a Flawless!
It can also fix Budding Entroized Fluix, using Ender Dust instead of Charged Certus Quartz.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.crystal_resonance_ge: This block makes 40 FE/t out of thin air! Sadly, you can only have one of them on any AE2 network.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.decorative_certus_bl: Certus quartz blocks can be stonecut into a variety of decorative blocks!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.digital_storage.desc: AE2 can store stuff digitally on storage cells. These have a byte limit (roughly corresponds to how many items can be stored in a cell, a byte stores 8 items) and a type limit (how many §odifferent§r item types can be stored). Even a 256k item storage cell will be fully filled with 63 iron axes of different damage values! (fresh iron axes will stack though - AE2 doesn't care about the item's stack size limit).
Cells are made from the Cell Housing, which sets the type of storage (item, fluid, etc.), and a Storage Component, which sets the byte limit.
For the system to read from storage cells, they must be placed into a connected ME Drive.
Cells can be formatted in the Cell Workbench to filter what items they accept.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.energy.title: Energy
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.energy.description.0: AE2 networks require energy to run. Any mod that generates energy will work, but AE2 itself also provides some crude solutions.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.energy_cell.title: Energy Cell
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.energy_cell.descript: This augments energy storage of the AE2 network, allowing it to, for example, make bigger crafts. Very relevant for Spatial IO. There's also an upgraded dense version.
This is a somewhat niche tool, but it can turn water into ice, which is nice §o(heh)§r if you need it for some other mod.
Also turns logs into charcoal, cobble into stone and lava into obsidian, as well as acts as a flint and steel.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.entro_crystals.title: Entro Crystals
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.entro_crystals.descr: Welcome to Extended AE! To start in this mod, you'll need a new type of resource, Entro Crystals. Craft an Entro Seed and click it on a Fluix Block: this will create a Budding Block that grows them. Growth Accelerators work!
There is no Flawless version of this, unfortunately, but you will get a way to prevent the decay down the line (@see Crystal Fixer)
An alloy of Entro Dust, Gold and Lapis Lazuli, made in the same way Fluix Crystals are. You need these to craft machine frames for this mod.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.extended_crafting.de: Extended Pattern Providers hold 36 patterns each, and Extended Molecular Assemblers can craft eight things at once!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.extended_drive.title: Extended Drive
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.extended_drive.descr: Can hold 20 Storage Cells compared to the normal Drive's 10.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.extended_interface.d: Has 36 configuration slots. I used these with Gregtech once :D
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.extended_pattern_acc: Finally, a Pattern Access Terminal with a search bar!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.fluix_crystals.title: Fluix Crystals
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.fluix_crystals.descr: This is an alloy of Redstone, Nether Quartz, and Charged Certus Quartz, obtained by throwing equal amounts of each item together into water. Or you can get it from villagers.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.formation_and_annihi: The Annihilation Plane is an import bus for blocks placed in the world: it breaks them and immediately pulls the drops into the system; it doesn't do this if there's nowhere to store the drops, so you can kinda filter it by only giving it access to storage of certain item types. It can be enchanted with Silk Touch or Fortune!

The Formation Plane, somewhat confusingly, is a §ostorage bus§r for blocks placed in the world: not an export bus! It places blocks from its filter into the world, but only when these blocks are actively imported into the system! You will probably need a subnet for this.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.going_wireless.title: Going Wireless
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.going_wireless.descr: Tired of running to your terminals every time you need to craft something? Luckily, we have a wireless version!
You need to click the terminal into the Wireless Access Point to link it.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.growth_accelerator.d: This block greatly accelerates certus quartz cluster growth. Place it by the budding block and give it energy (pro tip: this is the perfect use case for the Crystal Resonance Generator).
It can accelerate budding amethyst, too, as well as any other modded budding blocks and even crop growth (though for that you'll need to place it adjacent to the crop, not to farmland).
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.infinity_cells.title: Infinity Cells
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.infinity_cells.descr: Infinite water and cobblestone cells, courtesy of Extended AE!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.inscriber_presses.de: The four presses are Logic, Calculation, Engineering, and Silicon. You get these from breaking a Mysterious Cube, that spawns at the meteor.
You can duplicate presses by putting them through an inscriber with an iron block.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.io.title: IO
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.io.description.0.1: The Import Bus imports items §ointo§r the system, and the Export Bus exports §ofrom§r the system. The Export Bus needs to be filtered to tell it what to export.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.io.description.0.2: The Interface is an inventory that keeps items (fluids, etc.) in constant stock up to set amount. Click items (or drag from JEI) into the top slots to set what to stock, middle-click to change amount.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.io.description.0.3: Did you know? If you place a storage bus of one AE2 system on the interface of another, the first will gain access to the entire contentsof the second!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.level_emitter.title: Level Emitter
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.level_emitter.descri: These can be set to emit a redstone signal when the amount of items of a certain type stored in the system exceeds a certain value. Given that export buses etc. can be configured to only work with (or without)redstone signal with the use of a Redstone Card, this allows to make e.g. automatic off switches for passive processing lines.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.matter_condenser.des: This is a trash can, but it can also condense trashed items into Matter Balls (requires a 1k or larger Storage Part installed) or Singularities (requires a 64k or larger Storage Part).
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.me_canner.title: ME Canner
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.me_canner.descriptio: This machine can put fluids into buckets and take them back out.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.me_chest.title: ME Chest
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.me_chest.description: This block can be used to view contents of one cell at a time.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.me_io_port.title: ME IO Port
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.me_io_port.descripti: This block allows to quickly load and empty storage cells, exchanging contents between them and the main system.
This neat machine pairs great with the Pattern Provider. It can do crafting table, smithing table and stonecutter recipes, and auto-outputs the results.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.other_types_of_cells: AE2 can store more things than just items!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.p2p_tunnels.title: P2P Tunnels
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.p2p_tunnels.descript: P2P Tunnels are portals - a cable can come into one, come out of another, and it's like they're directly connected. P2P tunnels can be linked to one another with a Memory Card.
Different types of P2P tunnels support different cables: item and fluid pipes, energy cables, and even AE2's own cables carrying channels.
A connection between linked P2P tunnels takes one channel of the network.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.pattern_access_termi: This terminal allows you to access pattern storage of all Pattern Providers on your network remotely, so you don't have to go to the provider to place new patterns in.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.plushies.title: Plushies!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.printed_circuits_and: Presses process raw ingredients into printed circuits in the Inscriber. Logic takes gold ingots, Calculation takes certus crystals, Engineering takes diamonds (ouch) and Silicon takes... well, silicon.
Printed Silicon, put back into the inscriber with one of the other printed circuits and redstone dust, creates processors. These will be very important crafting ingredients going forward.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.quantum_network_brid: The Quantum Network Bridge is a multiblock that allows infinite-range crossdimensional connection to your AE2 system. Build two rings with a Quantum Link Chamber in the center - one connected to your controller with cables, the other one anywhere - and place two Quantum Entangled Singularities of the same pair in the chambers. Now you have access to the system from the second ring!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.quartz_fiber.title: Quartz Fiber
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.quartz_fiber.descrip: This is a crafting component, but it also has a purpose in itself. You can connect two cable lines through it and it will transfer energy, but not channels, allowing you to power one AE2 network from another.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.silicon.title: Silicon
Smelt Certus Quartz Dust to get this. Or smelt Quartz Blend, which is a one to §otwenty-four§r increase on your silicon output at the cost of some charcoal and sand.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.singularity.title: Singularity
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.singularity.descript: Singularities are a product of compressing many thousands of items in a Matter Condenser.
Blowing one up together with Ender Dust splits it into two Quantum Entangled Singularities.
These can then be used in a Quantum Network Bridge: see next quest.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.smart_cable.title: Smart Cable
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.smart_cable.descript: Smart Cable displays the amount of channels it is transferring! It also looks cool!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.spatial_anchor.title: Spatial Anchor
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.spatial_anchor.descr: This block makes your AE2 system always load all chunks it spans, within a single dimension.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.spatial_io.title: Spatial IO
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.spatial_io.descripti: Spatial IO allows you to cut and paste parts of the world, with all the blocks and entities in them. To use it, you should have a structure of Spatial Pylons on your AE2 network spanning the length of the box you're planning to cut, plus one block, on all three axes (the quest asks for 6, giving you a 1x1x1 working area to move e.g. a flawless budding certus block); a Spatial IO port; and an empty Spatial Storage Cell of adequate size to store the structure inside. Once everything is ready, place the cell inside the IO port and give the port a redstone signal.
To paste, construct a box of pylons of the same dimensions in another location and do the same procedure on a filled cell.
Spatial IO uses a lot of energy for the larger structures! Bring on your dense energy cells!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.starting_with_ae2.de: There are two ways to get your foot in the door of AE2, and both of them require the use of a Charger.
The common way is to charge a compass in the Charger, creating a Meteor Compass; it would then point you to the nearest meteor - a structure containing everything you need to start with the mod.

The fun way is villager trading. The Charger doubles as a villager profession block for a Fluix Researcher, that can sell you certus quartz and fluix crystals, sky stone, and at expert level - two random inscriber presses. You'll need several of these villagers to get the full set.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.storage.title: Storage
You need a place to store items in your AE system. There are two solutions: either store them digitally on storage cells or slap a storage bus on something.
There's a priority system for storage that can be configured for both. Items are first put into higher priority storage and first taken from lower priority storage.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.storage_bus.title: Storage Bus
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.storage_bus.descript: A Storage Bus can be placed on any chest, fluid tank or other modded container, and will provide access to its contents to the system. Can optionally be partitioned (filtered for content types) and set to import or export only.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.storage_monitor.desc: This fella displays the total amount of a filtered item that your system is storing!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.tag_and_mod_buses.de: These export items filtered by item tag or by mod that adds them! There are Storage Bus versions as well!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.terminal.title: Terminal
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.terminal.description: An AE system would be hard to use if it didn't have a visual interface to it. That's where the Terminal comes in! You can view your items from it, put them in, take them out, search, and in the upgraded version, the Crafting Terminal, you can even craft with all the items at your disposal. (Honestly, why does the regular terminal even exist?)
You can place this on any cable that isn't dense.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.the_start_of_autocra: Arguably the most powerful part of AE2 is its ability to autocraft. Create patterns for things in a Pattern Encoding Terminal and place them into a Pattern Provider attached to a machine that crafts them, and the provider will insert ingredients into the machine when requested.
You can attach several machines at once to different sides of the Pattern Provider and it will use all of them if there are enough co-processing threads (see next quest).
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.upgrade_cards.title: Upgrade Cards
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.upgrade_cards.descri: These are the base for making all sorts of upgrades to your AE2 machines!
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.vibration_chamber.de: The Vibration Chamber is AE2's coal generator, making 80 FE/t. It accepts Acceleration Cards for increased production speed and Energy Cards for increased fuel efficiency.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.void_cell.title: Void Cell
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.void_cell.descriptio: Extended AE allows you to have a pocket Matter Condenser in the form of a Storage Cell! Pro tip: it works wonders in on a subnet with an infinite cobblestone cell being imported from in a ME IO port :D
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.where_am_i.title: Where am I??
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.where_am_i.descripti: You can teleport §oyourself§r to the Spatial Storage pocket dimension if you stand inside the box while it's cut! Now how would I get out of here...
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.wireless_booster.des: By default, a Wireless Access Point only covers a range of 16 blocks. This range can be extended with boosters up to 528 blocks, at the cost of energy. Alternatively, you can use a Quantum Network Bridge for infinite range, cross-dimensional access.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.wireless_connector.d: Pairs of these blocks can facilitate wireless connections and are much less bulky than Quantum Network Bridges! Though unlike these, they can't work cross-dimensionally and also eat energy proportional to distance between the pair.
To link the pair to one another, use the Wireless Setup Kit.
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.wireless_hub.title: Wireless Hub
eqpack.quest.oq_ae2.wireless_hub.descrip: A version of the Wireless Connector that can connect to up to 8 others at once.
eqpack.chapter.oq_aether.title: The Aether
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.aerbunnies.title: Aerbunnies!!!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.aerbunnies.descri: Aerbunnies are helpful little cuties! If you grab one in your hands, you will be falling slower, jumping higher, taking no fall damage and also you'll be able to jump in the air every once in a while (not enough to ascend, but enough to be descending very slowly
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.aerclouds.title: Aerclouds
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.aerclouds.descrip: These safely break your fall, and the Blue version can launch you into the air, very useful for mobility!
Here's a fun thing for you: place a Blue Aercloud against the ceiling, jump into it and see what happens :D
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.aether_tools.desc: Tools made out of Aether materials mine Aether blocks faster!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.altar.title: Altar
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.altar.description: This block is powered by Ambrosium and can repair damaged items, as well as do some unique recipes!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.ambrosium.title: Ambrosium
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.ambrosium.descrip: Aether's version of coal! It can craft ambrosium torches (normal torches burn out here), smelts items, and can directly restore health when eaten like it's the golden days of Minecraft :D
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.book_of_lore.desc: In-game documentation for the mod! You have to place the items in it for it to tell you about them though.
Alternatively, you can check out the official wiki at §ehttps://aether.wiki.gg/§r!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.bronze_dungeon.de: These are the trickiest to spot out of all thee dungeons, as entrances to them hide on the side of islands; they are wide tunnels made out of Holystone and Mossy Holystone. The dungeon itself is home to a bunch of trapped blocks (don't step on them or a mob will be summoned! this is a common theme between the Bronze and Silver dungeons) and the Slider, which is a boss you can only damage with a pickaxe. Defeating him will grant you a key to open his loot chest.
A rare drop from presents, if has a chance of dropping Candy Canes when hitting mobs with it!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.darts.title: Darts
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.darts.description: The Aether adds a new type of weapon, the Dart Shooter! It can be upgraded at the Altar!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.enchanted_graviti: This is a material for the strongest of the conventional Aether gear sets, only slightly weaker than Netherite. It has funky effects on gravity: mobs you fight with a Gravitite Sword will be launched in the air, and with a pickaxe you can launch blocks!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.freezer.title: Freezer
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.freezer.descripti: Icestone is an unusual ore of the Aether that can be used to craft and power the Freezer - a block that can freeze water all the way to blue ice!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.gloves.title: Gloves
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.gloves.descriptio: Gloves are accessories giving you a bonus to attack damage!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.golden_amber.desc: Dropped from Golden Oak Logs when mined with a Zanite or Gravitite Axe.
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.gold_dungeon.desc: These hide in the spherical islands floating high in the sky, with golden trees on top. There is only one room, that of the boss - the Sun Spirit; after a long conversation with him you can enter a fight with him, in which you'll need to redirect his blue projectiles back at him to make him vulnerable. Try not to burn!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.gravitite_ore.des: Unlike most ores, it always drops itself and can't be smelted; you'll have to process it at the Altar!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.gummies.title: Gummies!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.gummies.descripti: This is some really good stuff, they regenerate your entire hunger bar!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.healing_stone.des: Provides Regeneration for 30 seconds when eaten and is very cheap to make in bulk!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.life_shard.title: Life Shard
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.life_shard.descri: Rare loot from Gold Dungeons. Can be consumed to give the player one extra permanent heart! Effects of multiple of them stack!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.music_discs.title: Music Discs
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.music_discs.descr: The Aether has five music discs of varying secrecy, hidden from the creative inventory and some even from JEI! Two of these are found in dungeons, two can be made with an altar and one with a freezer!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.parachutes.title: Parachutes
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.parachutes.descri: Can slow down your fall, but have limited uses :/
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.presents.title: Presents
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.presents.descript: Rarely in the Aether you will find holiday trees with some presents under them. Be careful, they can blow up... or give you some fun loot!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.regeneration_ston: Provides a small amount of regeneration, effects of multiple stones stack!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.silver_dungeon.de: These are big temples proudly standing in the open, home to the Valkyries. You'll have to navigate a multifloor maze to get to the Valkyrie Queen's chamber and collect ten Victory Medals from her adepts to challenge her to a fight.
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.sun_altar.title: Sun Altar
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.sun_altar.descrip: Drops from the Sun Spirit and allows you to control time of day in the Aether!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.swet_ball.title: Swet Ball
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.swet_ball.descrip: These drop from Blue Swets - little slimes who try to get you killed - and can be substituted for slime :D
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.welcome_to_the_ae: Build the iconic glowstone portal and pour water inside! Trust me, it'll work this time :)
Did you know? If you fall into the Void in the Aether, you'll just be teleported back to the Overworld!
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.zanite.title: Zanite
eqpack.quest.oq_aether.zanite.descriptio: An Aether material about the level of iron!
eqpack.chapter.oq_ars.title: Ars Nouveau
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.alakarkinos.title: Alakarkinos
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.alakarkinos.descript: This handsome gentleman can sift archaeology loot out of regular sand and gravel! Pottery sherds are now renewable!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.alchemist_s_crown.de: Their names were to be replaced by shades ascending from scarlet
Instantly drink potions! It's a shame this doesn't display on your player model, it's beautiful...
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.amethyst_golems.desc: This yonic-looking item can be used to summon Amethyst Golems, which can farm Amethyst! The charm drops from the golems upon the use of a Dispel spell. Set their home to a chest with a Dominion Wand, and they will deposit collected amethyst shards there!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.arcane_pedestals.des: These can hold one item at a time; apart from being useful for sourcelink automation (mycelial and volcanic sourcelinks can take items from them), they can also provide crafting catalysts for imbuing Essences!
They can also be crafted into a platform version, which works for all the same things, but is smaller and can be placed on walls or upside down.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.archmage_s_spell_boo: Tier 3 spells are within your reach!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.archwood.title: Archwood
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.archwood.description: Find a colorful Archwood Tree and collect its logs!
Did you know these grow from a single sapling despite being two by two blocks thick? You can revolutionize your wood farm with them!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.ars_essences.title: Ars Essences
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.ars_essences.descrip: These are needed for making many of the spell glyphs! All of them are made in an Imbuement Chamber with three adjacent pedestals providing crafting catalysts, which are not consumed.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.augment_arrows.title: Augment Arrows
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.augment_arrows.descr: These can be used in an Enchanter's Bow!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.bookwyrms_and_the_st: This is Ars Nouveau's storage system! It's very easy to assemble and use, accessible relatively earlygame!

Use Bookwyrm charms on a Storage Lectern to summon Bookwyrms in; they are the «cables» of the system, in a matter of speaking. Then use the Dominion Wand to link the lectern to inventories; every bookwyrm can support up to eight inventories, which can be chests or any modded containers.
§oNota Bene:§r items in all unlinked containers placed directly against the Storage Lectern will be automagically imported into the system!
When placed on an Advanced Spell Prism, adds glyphs inscribed on it to passing projectiles, fully escaping the glyph count limit of 10 :D
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.current_elevators.de: These blocks allow for vertical movement similar to bubble columns, but both ways (depends on if you shift) and not just in water: the Bubble one works in water, the Slipstream in air (needs source to work) and the Magmatic in lava (this last one also gives fire resistance!)
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.display_case.title: Display Case
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.display_case.descrip: Not only can it display items, but you can also link it to an inventory and it will act as a smart comparator!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.dominion_wand.title: Dominion Wand
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.dominion_wand.descri: I know I just said Ars blocks all magically connect to each other, but that's only true of the simple blocks like Source Jars. More advanced sourcery requires the use of a Dominion Wand
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.dowsing_rod.title: Dowsing Rod
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.dowsing_rod.descript: This can help you find Amrethyst Geodes!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.drygmies.title: Drygmies
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.drygmies.description: Drygmy Tokens can be found in loot chests or obtained by giving a wild Drygmy a Wilden Horn. They can then be converted into Drygmy Charms.
To summon a Drygmy, use a Charm on a block of Mossy Cobblestone; this will convert the block into a Drygmy Henge. More drygmies can be summoned into said henge.

When provided source and an inventory adjacent to the henge to deposit items into, Drygmies will harmlessly simulate and collect drops from nearby mobs, including those in Containment Jars. The greater the variety of mobs, the happier the Drygmies and greater the output.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.enchanter_s_eye.desc: Casts a spell through a Scry Crystal!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.enchanter_s_horn.des: Casts the inscribed spell on everything in a large radius!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.enchanting_apparatus: This multiblock crafts most unique items in Ars Nouveau. It is made of an Arcane Core with an Enchanting Apparatus on top of it and eight Arcane Pedestals surrounding the core.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.familiars.title: Familiars
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.familiars.descriptio: Some creatures in Ars Nouveau can become your magical familiars! Perform a Ritual of Binding near them: after that you will be able to summon them from your spellbook!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.focus_of_summoning.d: Increases duration and damage of your summons and decreases the summoning cooldown!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_amplify.des: Arguably the most important glyph in the game, as it makes all other glyphs more powerful. In particular it makes the Break spell as powerful as a diamond pickaxe (which is why it requires one), so you can break obsidian really fast!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_animate_blo: Gives a block legs! It can't do much, but it will try to fight for you :3

If this entity is dispelled (or killed), the block falls back out, but it reverts to an item if it can't be placed (i'e' if it's within a blockspace of a torch), which allows you to get access to some normally unobtainable items like budding amethyst!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_aoe.title: Glyph of AOE
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_aoe.descrip: The big brother of the Glyph of Amplify, this augments specifically the block range of compatible spells.
The firework star required to craft this doesn't show a recipe in JEI/EMI, so in case you don't know how to craft it, it's gunpowder with any kind of dye.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_bounce.desc: Makes you bounce on everything, preventing fall damage. Useful with the glyph of Leap.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_burst.title: Glyph of Burst
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_burst.descr: Resolves the spell many times over in an area of effect - a better version of the Glyph of AOE!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_conjure_mag: Now you can shoot infinite magical torches! And applied to self, this gives night vision for a short time.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_craft.title: Glyph of Craft
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_craft.descr: Crafting table on a stick? No, crafting table in a spellbook!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_dispel.desc: Can be used to return Ars pets into their charms and release mobs out of Containment Jars!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_extract.des: Silk Touch for your break spell!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_fell.title: Glyph of Fell
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_fell.descri: Cuts trees down in like... three casts max :D
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_grow.title: Glyph of Grow
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_item_pickup: You can place it on a projectile+break spell and collect blocks from a great distance!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_leap.title: Glyph of Leap
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_leap.descri: Launches you in the direction you're facing. Slap a few amplifys on this bad boy and you've got yourself makeshift early-game flight!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_linger.desc: Transforms the spell into a lingering potion-type effect cloud that periodically applies it!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_luck.title: Glyph of Luck
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_luck.descri: Fortune for your break spell! Rabbit's feet are mighty annoying to get, though - consider a drygmy farm?
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_orbit.title: Glyph of Orbit
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_orbit.descr: Not to be confused with the Sharingan
Copies the remainder of the spell three times over into projectiles orbiting the current target.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_split.title: Glyph of Split
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_split.descr: Using this on a projectile creates an additional projectile, so twice the spell!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.glyph_of_summon_wolv: There are two wolves inside of you, and with this glyph you can summon them both to an outside fight!
A Tablet of Containment can be used to pick mobs up into Containment Jars! It needs source for every activation after the first. To release the mob, cast Dispel on the jar.
§oNota Bene:§r Containment Jars are not limited to mobs - they can contain pretty much any entity, including dropped items and even lightning bolts!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.magebloom.title: Magebloom
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.magebloom.descriptio: An arcane plant that grows magical fiber!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.magebloom_bed.title: Magebloom Bed
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.magebloom_bed.descri: Drygmies and Whirlisprigs have their home blocks, but what about the Starbuncles? Fear not, as you can give them an adorable pet bed! Everbloom, it's so soft I want to sleep in one :D
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.mage_robes.title: Mage Robes
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.mage_robes.descripti: You can make mage robes out of gold, iron or diamond armor, which give you increased mana reserves and mana regeneration! Higher tier base materials give more protection, but less thread slots (@see Threads and Alteration, also gold is considered a lower material than iron). It can also be directly upgraded with Nether and End materials to get more thread slots, and can be dyed!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.mage_s_spell_book.de: With some diamonds and blaze rods you can now cast Tier 2 glyphs!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.magical_lights.title: Magical lights
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.magical_lights.descr: Cast Touch -> Conjure Magelight on these to turn them on!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.magical_tools_and_we: There are quite a few different weapons in the arsenal of a sorcerer:
- Enchanter's Wand casts projectile spells, allowing to exceed the glyph cap a little,
- Enchanter's Mirror does the same with self spells,
- Enchanter's Sword casts Touch spells with increased damage,
- Enchanter's Gauntlet also casts with Touch and is a diamond-tier multitool,
- Enchanter's Fishing Rod casts a touch spell on the hooked entity §ocontinuously§r,
- Enchanter's Bow shoots arrows imbued with spells,
- Enchanter's Shield gives Mana Regeneration and Spell Damage when used,
- and the Splash Flask Cannon fires potions!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.making_source_gems.d: You will need an Imbuement Chamber to create the basic materials of Ars, the first of which, source gems, are made from either amethyst or lapis. For now they process rather slowly, but a way to speed it up is on the horizon!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.mirrorweave.title: Mirrorweave
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.mirrorweave.descript: Mirrorweave can take the appearance of any block, Falseweave is the same but you can walk through it, Ghostweave can make invisible walls and Skyweave mimics the appearance of the sky!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.novice_spell_book.de: With the power of shoving a variety of iron tools into a book, you are now a sorcerer!
The default keybind to opening the spellbook is C, then X and Z to switch between the ten spells in the book. Of course, you can change all of these.
Spells are made of several glyphs. Every spell starts with a form glyph, then one or several effect glyphs, optionally with one or several augment glyphs after each.
The spellbook also has documentation for the mod inside! Consult it if stuck!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.planarium.title: Planarium
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.potion_diffuser.desc: Spreads potions in an area of effect rather efficiently, at the cost of Source!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.potion_flask.title: Potion Flask
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.potion_flask.descrip: Stores up to 8 doses of a potion and can be drunk from in inventory.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.potion_jar.title: Potion Jar
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.potion_jar.descripti: Stores up to 100 doses of a potion!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.potion_melder.title: Potion Melder
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.potion_melder.descri: Mixes the effects of two potions into a single one!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.redstone_relay.title: Redstone Relay
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.repository.title: Repository
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.repository.descripti: A Repository has a double chest worth of storage space in a single block, and a Repository Catalog functions as a controller for all Repositories connected to it - so you can link a wall of them to a Storage Lectern by linking only one inventory!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.ritual_brazier.title: Ritual Brazier
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.ritual_brazier.descr: Rituals are magical effects cast from a Ritual Brazier. Some of them require source to operate, and some of them require augmentation with an item: to do that, toss the item needed into the brazier!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.runes.title: Runes
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.runes.description.0: Runes cast spells inscribed in them when an entity steps on them! Runes you can make with a Glyph of Rune are one-use, but you can reinforce them with Runic Chalk. They need source for each cast after the first.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.scribe_s_table.title: Scribe's Table
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.scribe_s_table.descr: Your new Spellbook doesn't have that many glyphs in it, but we can fix it with this new table! Click your spellbook on it, then you can select the glyph you want to craft. Toss the ingredients on the table to satisfy the craft!
§oNota Bene:§o the Scribe's Table can pull items out of nearby inventories to use once the glyph is selected!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.scryer_s_oculus.desc: Remote terminal for Scry Crystals, linked to them with Scryer's Scrolls.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.scry_crystal.title: Scry Crystal
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.simplest_glyphs.desc: Ars Nouveau has a lot of different glyphs, so for this and other similar sections I will only provide a handful which were most useful in my experience playing with the mod. In this section I'm showing Tier 1 glyhs that don't require elemental essences - so anything you can craft right out the gate without progressing into Ars further.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.source_berries.title: Source Berries
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.source_berries.descr: Source Berries grow in taigas and archwood forests! They give Mana Regeneration when eaten and can be crafted into more potent foods, as well as brewed into a Potion of Mana Regeneration.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.source_relay.title: Source Relay
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.spell_prism.title: Spell Prism
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.spell_prism.descript: Spell Prisms redirect spell projectiles passing through them. Advanced Spell Prisms can aim at a specific block.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.spell_sensor.title: Spell Sensor
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.spell_sensor.descrip: Emits a redstone signal when a spell is cast nearby
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.spell_turret.title: Spell Turret
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.spell_turret.descrip: These can cast spells for you using Source! To inscribe the parchment, place it on the Scribe's Table and shift-right-click with your spellbook with the spell selected.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.starbuncles.title: Starbuncles
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.starbuncles.descript: Starbuncles can move items between chests and collect Source Berries! To tell one where to deposit the items, use the Dominion Wand, and to obtain a starbuncle token in the first place, give a wild starbuncle a gold nugget.

§oNota Bene:§r if you like the color of a wild starbuncle, nametag it before giving it a gold nugget - this will give you a named token, which when converted into a charm will summon a starbuncle of the same name and color!
Performing this near Archwood Trees creates Weald Walkers, near Budding Amethyst - Amethyst Golems, and if you augment the ritual with a Book and Quill, you'll get a Bookwyrm charm!
If you can't find a pillager captain, this can summon a raid instead!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.tablet_of_flight.des: Creative flight - for the cost of source in a range around the brazier!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.tablet_of_harvest.de: Harvests crops in an area and deposits them into a nearby chest.
Intercepts hostile mob spawning in a large radius.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.tablet_of_scrying.de: Augment it with any block, and the ritual will highlight all blocks of the same time through walls. Yes, this is ore x-ray, but you can also search for e.g. mob spawner dungeons by scrying mossy cobblestone! Incredibly versatile :3
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.tablet_of_summon_wil: This can summon wilden mobs if you don't have any of their drops! Alternatively, you can augment it with one of each of Wilden Wing, Horn and Spike to summon a boss - the Wilden Chimera!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.threads_and_alterati: The Alteration Table allows you to weave a variety of different threags into your mage armor, which give different buffs.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.trinkets.title: Trinkets
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.trinkets.description: Ars Nouveau has a variety of trinkets providing boosts to things like mana regeneration! A Trinket Pouch can hold multiple of them and provide all the effects!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.warp_scrolls.title: Warp Scrolls
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.warp_scrolls.descrip: Warp scrolls are single-use teleports to a location set beforehand! The stabilized version has unlimited uses and can be used crossdimensionally. You can also throw one into a frame made of Sourcestone and/or Mirrorweave and it will create a portal to the scroll's stored location! Creating such a portal requires source, but using it doesn't.
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.whirlisprigs.title: Whirlisprigs
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.whirlisprigs.descrip: aren't they the cutest little florets :3

To obtain this §oadorable§r cutie's token, grow a tree near a wild one!~ You can summon it back by using the charm on any flower, which will convert said flower into a Whirlisprig Blossom - the cutie's new home!

Whirlisprigs duplicate plants (logs, flowers and even lilypads) around their home when provided with source and an output inventory, which should be adjacent to the flower. They are happiest when their home has a great variety of plants, leading to increased outputs!
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.wilden_drops.title: Wilden Drops
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.wilden_drops.descrip: These have three main ways of getting them: you either find them in a loot chest somewhere, or find a Wilden Den (a small hill with Wilden mobs spawning inside), or perform a Ritual of Summon Wilden (see the ritual quests).
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.wilden_tribute.title: Wilden Tribute
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.wixies.title: Wixies
eqpack.quest.oq_ars.wixies.description.1: Wixies are tiny with pixies that autocraft! They take items out of inventories linked with the Dominion Wand, and craft them into items placed on Arcane Pedestals adjacent to thieir home cauldron. They can also brew potions with Potion Jars!
Ars Nouveau utilises a form of substance called source for the functioning of its various apparata. It is not a fluid!

Source is generated by Sourcelinks, stored in Source Jars and used by many things, but for example, Imbuement Chambers run faster when it is provided. All of these components connect together by themselves - you don't need any pipes or linking tools! Magic!

Different Sourcelinks generate source from different things. Agronomic Sourcelinks do it from crop growth, Vitalic Sourcelinks from mobs breeding and dying, Mycelial from food, Volcanic from furnace fuel, and Alchemical from potions (you probably won't need that Sourcelink at the start).
§oNota Bene:§o the Mycelial Sourcelink generates extra source from Source Berries, the gathering of which can be automated with Starbuncles, see their quest further on!
eqpack.chapter.oq_blood_magic.title: Blood Magic
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.advanced_rit: These need an upgraded ritual diviner!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.alchemy_tabl: This is Blood Magic's third crafting station, allowing you to double ores, turn rotten flesh into leather, make cobwebs... as well as providing some unique Blood Magic recipes!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.arcane_ashes: This is the base of the fourth and final crafting method in Blood Magic: the Alchemy Array. Place the ashes on the ground, then click the required items in.
Don't trust JEI in the recipes that show bedrock as output! These are functional arrays that do things other than give you an item!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.blank_rune.d: This is your introduction to the Rune blocks, which are needed to extend the altar. The Blank Rune by itself does nothing to the altar except raise its level.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.charging_run: Gives the Blood Altar a second buffer, the contents of which enter into items on the altar instantly when crafting.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.crash_of_the: Cuts down trees in the working area.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.dagger_of_sa: With this weapon you can finally use life essence of other mobs at the altar! Near the altar it kills in one hit, and the more HP the mob had, the more life essence the altar receives.
The Demon Realm has within it an area called the mines, which is rather tricky and time-consuming to find. While you're opening doors, keep an eye on the chat for messages about a «spatial distortion». The first time that happens, the room you just opened will have a special seal you can't open with an Iron Key; mark it and keep exploring. The second time you will also have a room with a special seal, which leads you to a chest with a Foreman's Key; this is what you need to open the first seal, get back to it and you're in!
Iron Keys won't work in the Mines either; thankfully, the required Miner's Keys are craftable in the Hellfire Forge.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.divination_s: Shows the amount of life points stored in the Soul Network, as well as the level, fullness and capacity of a Blood Altar.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.edge_of_the_: To proceed to Tier IV of the Blood Altar, you'll need some ingredients from the Demon Realm. You can't quite reach the Demon Realm yet, but you can just about access the edge of it, which should be enough.

The Demon Realm is a procedurally generated dungeon that expands with the use of Iron Keys, summoning new rooms out of the void. The Edge only has four rooms, which you should have enough keys for in loot chests at the start of the dungeon, but for the real deal down the line you might need to craft more in the Hellfire Forge.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.hellfire_for: This is where you craft with Demon Will!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.intricate_he: This is what you're for in the Mines! These allow you to craft Reinforced Runes!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.mark_of_the_: A second meteor has hit the ritual
Summons a meteor full of ores from the heavens! A catalyst item is required to specify what kind of meteor: it must be dropped on top of the master ritual stone.

By default, the meteor will fall all the way down and destroy the ritual stones (and quite possibly you too). To prevent that, place a block of obsidian high in the sky directly above the centerpoint of the ritual, to catch the incoming meteor (obsidian is used so the block doesn't get destroyed).
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.pathway_to_t: Finally, we can properly enter the Demon Realm, and with a nice amount of ritual stones no less!

The first thing we're after here is Demonite, an ore spawning in some rooms. It will allow us to upgrade our Blood Altar to Tier V! If you find Hellforged Sand in the chests, take that too, it can be smelted into the same Hellforged Ingots!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.reap_of_the_: Harvests crops within an area (but does not gather the drops to a chest :/)
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.reinforced_r: There's a Reinforced version of every rune, they have twice the stats!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.reverence_of: Provides Creative Flight within range (max 100 blocks horizontally and 200 vertically).
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.rituals.desc: Blood Magic has a bunch of rituals, and with a Ritual Diviner you get access to some starting ones (the rest will come with the Tier IV of the Altar).
Every ritual requires a variable amount of Ritual Stones and one Master Ritual Stone; place the master one down and click on it with the diviner with the ritual selected to place the rest.
To activate a ritual, you need an Activation Crystal: click it on the Master Ritual Stone. This will consume a lot of LP from your Soul Network!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.ritual_of_ma: Pulls ores up to the surface
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.ritual_tinke: A useful tool for some rituals, able to move their area of effect, set a linked inventory etc.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.routing_node: Blood Magic has a wireless item transfer system! Per a network of nodes you'll need one Master Node - the network's controller; Input and Output Nodes; filters for them; and a Node Router to link them all together.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.runes_of_sel: Get more Life Essence out of your sacrifices!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.rune_of_acce: Provides an additional buff to Displacement and Charging runes, reducing their operation cooldown!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.rune_of_augm: This provides a multiplicative buff to capacity in comparison to the Rune of Capacity's linear one, so the more of these runes you have, the more each rune buffs the altar!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.rune_of_capa: Increases the storage buffer of the Blood Altar.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.rune_of_disp: The Blood Altar is rather finicky when it comes to fluid automation, limiting transfer by external pipe to 20 mb/s. Runes of Displacement can raise that limit by a multiplicative +20%% per rune.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.rune_of_the_: When drawing LP into the Soul Network, the capacity of the network is limited by the capacity of the orb on top of the altar. These runes augment that capacity.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.sanguine_sci: You can craft the guidebook for Blood Magic from a book and a block of glass!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.sentient_swo: Killing mobs with this sword drops Demon Will without the need for Soul Snares.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.sigil_of_the: and it's like the fog has lifted!
Places light sources at a distance, at a cost of LP of course!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.soul_snares_: Demon Will is the fuel for Blood Magic's second crafting station, the Hellfire Forge. To get some to start, make Soul Snares at the blood sltar and throw them at mobs - when killed, these mobs will drop Demon Will!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.tartaric_gem: When you have this in inventory, it absorbs and accumulates all the Demon Will you pick up.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.tau_fruit.de: In loot chests in the Demon Realm you'll find the Tau Fruit. You'll need to grow it to progress... but there are some requirements to that.
The fruit needs blood to grow into the Saturated version (which is what we need), and it draws that blood from mobs standing on top of it. It will then
need more blood in the same way for each growth stage until maturation.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.teleposer.de: Warp plates from Blood Magic! Link a Teleposition Focus to one and stick it in the other :D
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.teleposition: Warp to a Teleposer from anywhere!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.tier_iii_blo: To upgrade a Tier II blood altar to Tier III, you'll need 20 more Runes and 4 Glowstone or Shroomlight Blocks.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.tier_ii_bloo: To upgrade your Blood Altar to Tier II, you need a ring of 8 rune blocks of any type under it. The upgrades quickly get more complicated than this, refer to the guidebook!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.tier_ii_reso: A better Altar allows to craft better Slates.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.tier_iv_bloo: To upgrade a Tier III Blood Altar to Tier IV, you'll need 28 additional Runes and 4 Bloodstone Bricks.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.tier_i_resou: These are the first resources you can craft with Life Essence, required to upgrade your altar.

The Blood Orb is an accessor point for storing life essence in a personal wireless network called the Soul Network. Some processes in Blood Magic not directly tied to the altar still require Life Essence to be initiated; it is thus taken from this network.
§oNota Bene:§r the amount of life essence is also sometimes called life points, LP.
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.tier_v_blood: With 4 Hellforged Blocks and 52 additional Runes you can upgrade your Tier IV altar to the maximum tier!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.tier_v_resou: You have reached the top tiers of slate!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.water_and_la: Infinite fluids at the cost of LP!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.weak_blood_s: Now that you have the Saturated Tau, you need to put it together with a Sanguine Reverter into an Alchemical Reaction Chamber to procure Weak Blood Shards - which you need to craft the caps for the next tier of altar, as well as your next blood orb.
Fun fact: the texture of the Alchemical Reaction Chamber with the Reverter inside used to be missing for a very long time :D
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.welcome_to_b: In this mod you'll be working with Life Essence (definitely not blood), which is a type of fluid. To start getting some, create and place down a Blood Altar and click with a Sacrificial Knife near it to extract some of your own life into it. You can then use it for crafts!
eqpack.quest.oq_blood_magic.well_of_suff: Drains life essence from mobs in the area and puts it into a Blood Altar.
eqpack.chapter.oq_direthings.title: Just Dire Things
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.advanced_mach: Advanced Machines do the same things as their Simple counterparts, but in a configurable area up to 11x11x11 blocks! As a tradeoff, they require energy to run.
§oNota Bene:§r these machines can be filtered many different ways - what blocks to break (either by block or by dropped item), what blocks to place blocks on or to target when clicking, etc.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.advanced_poly: In addition to the random polymorphing the regular wand can do, this can perform targeted polymorph - store any entity (even modded ones not present in the random pool!) as the target by shift-right click, then all targeted uses of the wand will make this type of entity! It even ignores the «hostile to hostile, passive to passive» rule. Targeted polymorphs cost a bit more polymorphic fluid (250 mb as compared to 100 mb of random ones).
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.advanced_port: This portal gun can save up to 12 locations and open portals to them after! The default keybind to access its UI is V. In addition to energy, it needs portal fluid to work, which can only be created in the End.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.advanced_swap: You'll need this for automating Time Crystal production!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.blazegold.des: The second-tier Goo is the Blazebloom Goo, which needs materials from the Nether to craft and be fed (blaze powder and nether wart are its activation fuel). It can create Raw Blazegold Ore from Blazegold blocks, but it can also create Ferricore from iron, so you don't need to keep the old goo around (in general, higher-tier goo can do all the recipes lower-tier goo can).
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.blazegold_too: Besides new upgrades, these have a feature of lava repair - throw them in lava and they will fully repair, converting the lava block to obsidian! (I know this sounds like a troll but trust me it works :D)
Any Blazegold Tool or Armor Piece
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.blazejet_wand: This is the first in the progression line of three wands, and it gives you an unlimited dash into the air - so makeshift flight! It even is nice enough to cancel all fall damage while you hold it in the main hand or offhand! It uses durability; repair it by tossing it in lava.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.celestigem.de: This is made from Diamond Blocks, and the new tier of Goo requires materials from the End! It's the only material of the main four that does not need to be smelted before it can be used.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.celestigem_to: These are unbreakable! Instead of durability, they use energy :D
Any Blazegold Tool or Armor Piece
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.creature_catc: Throw this at a mob to capture it!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.eclipsegate_w: In addition to the abilities of the Voidshift Wand, this wand can temporarily make blocks transparent! It creates a tunnel 3x3 wide ans up to 20 blocks deep, and it does not affect block entities and unbreakable blocks.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.eclipse_alloy: This needs entire Blocks of Netherite to be created, and materials from the Deep Dark for the goo! Though with the Ore Scanner and Hammer upgrades netherite mining is a little easier :)
These have fifty times the energy buffer of celestigem ones!
Any Blazegold Tool or Armor Piece
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.energy_transm: Wireless charging of machines in an area!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.experience_ho: You can save your player experience into this, but it can also absorb experience orbs from an area and push/pull experience with nearby players, for example, automatically setting you to exactly 30 levels for enchanting!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.ferricore.des: This mod's materials are created with the use of Goo; there are four tiers of Goo and four tiers of materials. The first goo is Primogel Goo: to use it, feed it either sugar or rotten flesh and place iron blocks adjacent to it; the goo will slowly spread converting the blocks to clusters of raw ferricore.
§oNota Bene:§r all raw ore clusters in Just Dire Things break 3-4 of their material, which is not affected by Fortune!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.ferricore_too: Just Dire Things adds armor and tools for all of its material levels; they are upgradeable (with smithing templates), but can also be crafted from scratch at any tier.
Any Ferricore Tool or Armor Piece
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.fluid_caniste: Holds eight buckets of fluid and can be toggled into fill mode in which it transfers the contained fluid to all other items in the inventory that can accept it - like polymorphic fluid into a polymorphic wand.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.fuel_canister: Put furnace fuel into this to aggregate a lot of furnace burn time into a single item!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.generators.de: A simple way to generate energy native to Just Dire Things is burning furnace fuel for 60 FE/t. A Simple Coal Generator does this in block form, while a Pocket Generator makes energy in your inventory and uses it to charge any gadgets that accept energy. 450 1300 4000
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.inventory_hol: This is a weird block with its main purpose being doing a fast inventory swap, but it also retains inventory when broken so it's practically a shulkerbox alternative!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.item_collecto: This powerful Ferricore-tier machine deserves its own quest! It can collect items in a configurable area and put them into a chest it's attach to; moreover, it collects block and mob drops before they are even spawned in the world as item entities, saving on lag! It can of course be filtered :D
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.paradox_machi: The Paradox Machine is a powerful duplication engine that, with default configs, works on all mobs and ores (but nothing else). Snapshot the area, then remove the snapshotted blocks/mobs; now you can revert to the snapshot at the cost of some Time Fluid! Note that the Paradox Machine takes a constant amount of time to restore a single block/mob, so there's no need to add more than one of the same type.

Every few hundred activations the Paradox Machine spawns a paradox in the center of its working area, which then jams it preventing further activation. To resolve the paradox and return to normal functioning, drop a Time Crystal item at it.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.paxels.title: Paxels
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.paxels.descri: Celestigem and Eclipse Alloy have all-in-one tools!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.player_access: This block allows automation to interact with the contents of your inventory!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.polymorphic_w: This is a fun toy! It can transmute mobs into random other mobs - passive to passive and hostile to hostile. With it you can get all sorts of rare mobs without exploring and even create zombie horses!
It uses Polymorphic Fluid for transformations, which is made by throwing Polymorphic Catalyst into water.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.portal_gun.de: Unlike its prototype by Aperture Science, this one does not need a solid surface for the portals to open! Otherwise it works like you'd expect :)
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.potion_canist: Holds four doses of a single potion type!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.primal_coal.d: Alongside the four main materials, Just Dire Things also adds four tiers of coal - upgooed from blocks of one another starting with blocks of coal. Each next tier smelts three times more items since you get minimum three of them per a block (nine) of the previous tier - but with a chance of getting a 4th drop upgooing your coal actually becomes profitable!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.scanner_upgra: Detect all mobs/all ores in a 10-block cubic radius and highlight them with particles visible through walls.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.simple_fuel_g: Dire coal starting at tier 2 (blaze ember) also has corresponding fluid forms. These can be used to run the Simple Fuel Generator for greater and faster energy production than what the solid-burning generators provide. All fuel burns at a rate of 1 mb/t, with Blaze Ember fuel giving 450 FE/t, Voidflame Fuel - 1300 FE/t, and Eclipse Ember Fuel - 4000 FE/t.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.simple_machin: These machines simulate player action in the block right in front of them, and don't even require power for it! There's a Block Placer, Block Breaker (needs a tool in inventory to break blocks with), Fluid Placer and Collector, Dropper, Clicker and Sensor - the last being a smart observer that emits a redstone signal upon detecting a block, item or entity it's configured to look for!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.simple_swappe: A pair of these swap the blocks they look at! To bind them to one another, use a Ferricore Wrench. They work cross-dimensionally, but sadly not on unbreakable blocks like bedrock.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.time_crystals: These are a fun automation challenge! Budding time crystal blocks are created from budding amethyst using goo, but to start actually growing time crystal clusters, they need to absorb energy of all three dimensions - the Overworld, the Nether and the End! Advanced block swappers are probably necessary to get the blocks on a ride through these dimensions, maybe with some advanced sensor action to detect the budding block's state!
§oNota Bene:§r budding time crystal blocks work §owondrously§r with AE2 Growth Accelerators!
When you have Time Crystals in your inventory, you will be randomly affected by high levels of Speed and Slowness. Upgrade: Time Protection is needed to negate that effect.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.time_wand.des: Charged with Time Fluid, this variation of a sonic screwdriver accelerates ticking of block entities - so any modded machines that process something over time!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.totem_of_deat: If you have this in your inventory when you die, you will respawn with an enchanted version that when used, teleports you to the place of your death. One-time use.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.upgrades.desc: Dire Things' tools and armor can be upgraded with special upgrade modules, giving them a variety of useful quirks! There are only a few availible at Ferricore tier, but every next tier of base material unlocks more!
Upgrades are installed at the smithing table (tool/armor piece in second slot, upgrade in third slot). To toggle them and configure their keybinds, shift-rightclick the upgraded item into the air.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.upgrade_death: A totem of undying with a 5-minute cooldown.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.upgrade_debuf: Remove all negative effects, with a cooldown!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.upgrade_drops: Bind an inventory (shift-right click) to the tool: now everything broken with this tool will teleport there.

§oNota Bene:§r farmland created with a Celestigem or Eclipse Alloy hoe with a Drops Teleporter upgrade will automatically harvest crops and teleport their drops into the inventory bound to the original hoe.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.upgrade_hamme: Mine in a 3x3 tunnel! Upgrades with the level of tool.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.upgrade_invul: For a few seconds and with a cooldown, but still!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.upgrade_time_: No more random effects from time crystals!
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.upgrade_treef: Chops trees in one block break! The Leafbreaker upgrade also takes care of the leaves.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.voidshift_wan: In addition to upgrading the launch that comes with the Blazejet Wand, this wand allows you to teleport up to 15 blocks in the direction you're facing (but not through blocks). You'll need to set a keybind to open the UI where you can toggle between the two abilities.
eqpack.quest.oq_direthings.x_ray_upgrade: These work in a 20-block cubic radius! The ore one shows the ores, but the mob one only shows outlines of the mobs (by giving the mobs the Glowing effect).
eqpack.chapter.oq_mekanism.title: Mekanism
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.advanced_solar_: Makes 76.8 FE/t passively during the day.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.advanced_tier.d: More advanced Mekanism machines require Infused Alloy, which is an infusion of redstone on copper.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.antimatter.desc: The most energy-dense material in all of modded Minecraft!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.antiprotonic_nu: This mouthwash of a machine can make a variety of items with the help of Antimatter, including Hearts of the Sea, Nautilus Shells, Tridents, Echo Shards, Dragon Eggs and Enchanted Golden Apples!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.basic_tier.desc: The most simple Mekanism machines require steel and basic control circuits to make. These are respectively a double coal infusion of iron and a redstone infusion of osmium.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.cardboard_box.d: These can be used to move blocks without breaking them! They even work on normally immovable blocks, like Spawners. Not on unbreakable blocks, though.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.chemical_infuse: Sulfuric Acid and Hydrogen Chloride are made here.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.chemical_transf: Mekanism adds a new state of matter, Chemicals - basically gases! They need their own tubes for transportation :3
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.combiner.title: Combiner
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.combiner.descri: This is not very useful, but it can wax copper and make glow ink sacs.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.crusher.title: Crusher
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.crusher.descrip: Crushes ingots to dust and makes biofuel. Can also process ancient debris into §othree§r netherite scrap together with the Enrichment Chamber!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.digital_miner.d: This machine can mine blocks from the world remotely in a 32-block cylindrical radius. It supports item stacks and tag filter, and can even Silk Touch!
Example: the item tag for lead ore is c:ores/lead
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.dimensional_sta: Mekanism's chunk loader, can be configured to load any selection of chunks in a 5x5 radius. Eats 2000 RF/t per chunk.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.dynamic_tank.de: Multiblock boxes for storing huge amounts of fluids and chemicals. The quest asks for a minimal 3x3x3 one, which already stores nine thousand buckets of fluids or §o432 thousand buckets§r of chemicals. The Dynamic Tank blocks are the frame, valves and glass go on the faces.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.electrolytic_se: Separates Water into Oxygen and Hydrogen.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.elite_tier.desc: Diamond infusions are needed for Elite-tier machines.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.energy_transfer: Universal Cables transport energy, and Energy Cubes are batteries!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.enrichment_cham: The Enrichment Chamber allows you to enrich infusion catalysts, multiplying their infusion capabilities by 8. Conserve your resources!
It can also increase output of ores: 3 raw ore become 4 dust.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.fissile_fuel.de: Making fissile fuel is a rather involved process requiring many machines! I'm going to give you tasks for base ingredients and all the moving parts, but figuring out how it all works together is best left as an exercise for the reader - Minecraft is a sandbox game! (Just maybe plan with expandability in mind)
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.fission_reactor: This multiblock makes both Nuclear Waste, processing which unlocks some endgame resources, and copious amounts of Steam, which can be reprocessed into copious amounts of energy in the Turbine (see next quests).

It can be built in any size you want up to 18x18x18, and bigger ones can handle higher fuel burn rate. I don't know how powerful your fissile fuel setup is, so I'm just going to set scalable components to 1 and hope you figure it out, okay?

The casing goes on the frame, glass or casing can be walls (I personally like using casing on the top and bottom and glass on the sides, to be able to see into the reactor, but you do you). Ports go into the walls too (you can set what port does what with the Configurator). Fission Fuel Assembly goes inside in a checkerboard pattern of pillars, and Control Rod Assembly goes on the top block of these pillars just below the roof. Just Enough Mekanism Multiblocks is an amazing JEI addon that can help you calculate the amounts of everything you need based on size and/or desired burn rate!

The reactor takes Fissile Fuel and Water as inputs, and outputs Steam and Nuclear Waste, that's why you need four ports. The quantities of Water and Steam handled become ludicrous with high burn rates! Pro tip: all ports auto-pull and auto-push, and Mekanism pipes and tubes can handle up to their total size a tick of fluid/chemical when they're not the ones doing the pulling and pushing, so it might be a good use case for the Great Wall of Pipe (if you got something that pushes water).
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.fluid_transfer_: Fun fact: Mekanism Fluid Tanks also work as large buckets! Shift+scroll wheel to turn bucket mode on and off.
They can also fill and empty buckets and other fluid containers.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.formulaic_assem: Mekanism's electric crafter. Needs a Crafting Formula to run in perpetuity.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.frickin_laser_b: These consume power to break blocks. Any blocks. At a distance. Or kill mobs (that includes YOU).

Laser Amplifiers can redirect laser beams, as well as unite the power of several Lasers (as they have a rather modest power consumption limit). Their internal UI can be configured to accumulate power up to a certain amount, then shoot it all out in one burst. That's exactly what you need for your Fusion Reactor!
Laser Tractor Beams are upgraded Laser Amplifiers that collect all the blocks they break. That's one way of automatic quarrying!
The Fusion Reactor is an egg-shaped multiblock (technically it's a truncated cube, but what do I know). Each of its six sides should look like this:

where white is frame, gray is glass and black is empty space. The controller goes into the center of the top face, the focus matrix into the center of any of the sides, and the ports replace any other glass.

The Fusion reactor takes D-T Fuel to operate, which is made from Tritium (solar neutron-activated Lithium from thermal evaporation plants) and Deuterium (electrolyze heavy water, which comes from electric pumps with a filter upgrade). It can also accept the two separately, though in this case the injection rate is limited to 10 mB/tick.

The Fusion Reactor produces tremendous 200 §omillion§r FE from every bucket of D-T fuel, but it has some funky jumpstart requirements. You'll need to place a Hohlraum full of D-T Fuel into the controller block, then fire a laser beam into the Focus Matrix with at least 400 MFE stored! Look up the laser quest for info on how these work.
Unlike Fission Reactors, these don't blow up! Ever! But they can stop if they run out of fuel :/ which may very well happen given that Tritium is only produced in the day. Account for that!

The maximum these can produce is 200 MFE/t, with 1000mb/t of D-T fuel, so 500 of deuterium and 500 of tritium; this needs a whopping 50 max-upgraded Electric Pumps to be sustained on deuterium, and two max-upgraded Chemical Infusers to mix the two!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.gas_burning_gen: Makes up to 72 §othousand§r FE/t when topped up with ethene, clearly your best option :D
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.hazmat_suit.des: If your reactor does melt down, this will save you from radiation!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.hdpe_sheets.des: You'll need some of these for endgame stuff! It's a multistep mostly PRC processing line!
The first of Mekanism's generators. Surround it with lava source blocks to make it work. You can even lavalog it!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.induction_matri: With fully upgraded interiors this box can store trillions of FE! Use the Configurator to change ports between input and output.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.industrial_alar: §o§6ATTENTION! EMERGENCY SITUATION! LEAVE THE BUILDING IMMEDIATELY USING EMERGENCY EXITS!§r
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.item_transfer_a: Little known fact: Mekanism adds drawers for storing large amounts of single items, called bins!
The item pipes (logistical transporters) are not very good on the lag side, though :(
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.jetpack.title: Jetpack
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.jetpack.descrip: The Jetpack allows you to fly at the cost of Hydrogen! There is also an Armored version providing more defense!
The Free Runners pair greatly with the Jetpack, negating all fall damage at the cost of energy.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.lithium_dust.de: Now we can make some §oproper§r batteries!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.logistical_sort: A way to filter what to push into Losistical Transporters. Can someone please help me figure out how it works?
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.mekasuit.title: MekaSuit
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.mekasuit.descri: This is Mekanism's endgame armor! As long as it is charged, you are invincible - the damage is absorbed by energy shields! There's also an all-in-one tool that goes with it, and both are upgradeable with different cards!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.metallurgic_inf: This machine can make you steel and other foundational alloys.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.nutritional_liq: The Nutritional Liquifier creates Nutritional Paste out of food. You can then consume it from the Canteen.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.oredictionifica: Converts between different mods' versions of the same resources. Is not related to orchiectomy :3
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.ore_doubling.de: You can now upgrade from 3:4 ore processing to straight up doubling with the Purification Chamber! It needs Oxygen to run, which can be made in the Electrolytic Separator.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.ore_quadrupling: Slap these three machines on the front of your ore tripling setup! The Chemical Dissolution Chamber needs Sulfuric Acid to run, which is made in a Chemical Infuser.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.ore_tripling.de: Not quite tripling: three ore become eight dust.
Add a Chemical Injection Chamber on the front of your ore doubling setup. It needs Salt or Hydrogen Chloride to run, both of which are made from Brine.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.osmium_compress: We'll need this machine later down the line to create Refined Obsidian Ingots.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.painting_machin: Recolor everything that can be recolored!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.personal_storag: These are double-chest-sized shulkerboxes that you can also open in your inventory. OP!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.plutonium.title: Plutonium
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.plutonium.descr: This is are made in an Isotopic Centrifuge, and the pellets in the PRC with Fluorite Dust!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.polonium.title: Polonium
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.polonium.descri: Solar Neutron Activators reprocess Nuclear Waste into Polonium, arguably the more important out of the two materials! They need direct access to sunlight to work, nighttime, rain or solid blocks above prevent the processing!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.portable_telepo: Go to any of your teleporters from anywhere!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.precision_sawmi: Not only can the Precision Sawmill give you more planks on your logs, it also produces Sawdust, which has a couple neat uses.
