eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.pressurized_rea: Creates Sulfur from Coal, Ethene and Substrate from Biofuel, and HDPE Pellets from Substrate.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.qio.title: QIO
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.qio.description: QIO is Mekanism's digital item storage system! As with other Mekanism's quantum doohickeys, it operates on a frequency system: create a new frequency value and set all devices to the same frequency to link them. It does not require power whatsoever!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.qio_redstone_ad: This device emits a redstone signal when the amount of a set item in the QIO system is above or below a set value, same as AE2's Level Emitter.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.quantum_entangl: Ender storage for anything from chemicals to fluids to energy: any two entangloporters on the same frequency have access to the same set of buffers.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.refined_obsidia: Many of the Ultimate machines require refined obsidian in ingot form.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.rotary_condense: Converts Chemicals into their fluid versions and vice versa.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.salt.title: Salt
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.salt.descriptio: This simplifies our ore processing setup a lot!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.seismic_vibrato: Prospects blocks underground by vertical layer. Can be used to detect caves.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.simple_generato: Here lies most of the Mekanism's collection of single-block energy generators!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.solar_generator: Makes 12.8 FE/t passively during the day.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.sps.title: SPS
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.sps.description: This machine reprocesses Polonium into small amounts of Antimatter! It eats through LUDICROUS quantities of energy; maybe consider making a Fusion Reactor?
It is built in the shape of a rounded cube. Every one of the six sides should look like this:

where white squares are casing, gray squares are glass and black squares are empty space. SPS Ports go into the centers of some faces, with the Supercharged Coil on one of them inside the block. You'll need at least three ports for inputting Polonium and Energy and outputting Antimatter, like with all other ports the Configurator can change input to output.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.staying_safe.de: Fission Reactors can melt down and irradiate the area if there's too much waste or not enough coolant! Thankfully, there is a way to prevent that: the Fission Reactor Logic Adapters. They go in the walls of the reactor.

They can work in either one of four problem detection mode, outputting a redstone signal when the corresponding problem is happening, or in activation mode, where the reactor only runs if the port receives a redstone signal. You'll need a NOT redstone gate!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.teleporter.desc: Custom portals! Build a frame with 2x1 interior space (teleporter block goes on the bottom, also you need to power it), create a new frequency in it, then do the same on the other side and set it to the same frequency.
Note: you don't need the frame or power on the receiving side if you're fine with a one-way portal, but you do need it chunkloaded.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.thermal_evapora: This multiblock creates Brine out of Water and Liquid Lithium out of Brine, which in turn give us access to Salt and Lithium Dust. Don't ask how it chemically works :)

The multiblock is a 4x4 square tower with height between 3 and 18 and no top face nor corners on the top layers. Valves and Controller go on the sides. It needs heat to run: you can connect a Resistive Heater to one of the valves and/or place Advanced Solar generators in the top corners to harness the heat of the Sun.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.the_io_of_qio.d: Isn't it marvelous how these don't need any cables?
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.tier_installers: These upgrade most simple Mekanism machines, making them run three processes at a time. There are Advanced, Elite, and Ultimate versions for even more parallelization.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.turbine.title: Turbine
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.turbine.descrip: This is what actually gives you power for your Steam!

It's a funky construction, it's kind of like a box made of two boxes? The frame is made of casing and the glass goes on the walls, yes, but only up to a certain height. In this lower compartment the rotor goes in a 1x1 pillar in the middle (so the box has to be odd and equal on width and length) and the blades should be clicked on the rotor; the ceiling of this compartment is made of pressure dispersers, with the rotational complex in the center directly on top of the blades. The walls and ceiling of the top compartment are made of turbine vents, electromagnetic coils go inside on top of the rotational complex, with the saturating condensers filling the rest of the space in free form.
For the love of the Everbloom, please use Just Enough Mekanism Multiblocks and play with all the settings to calculate how much of everything you need!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.ultimate_tier.d: For the Ultimate tier you need a new material, Refined Obsidian, which is a diamond infusion of obsidian dust.
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.upgrades.title: Upgrades
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.upgrades.descri: Speed Upgrades increase the rate of production, Energy Upgrades increase energy efficiency, and Chemical Upgrades decrease consumption of chemicals for machines that use chemicals (such as the Purification Chamber). Do not overlook Chemical Upgrades!
eqpack.quest.oq_mekanism.welcome_to_meka: The first material you need to get for this mod is Osmium, which comes from an ore found underground.
Makes passive energy proportional to its elevation, up to 192 FE/t at build limit.

eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.additiona: The &6Siphon&r is a tool used to extract input fluids from a machine. Right-clicking a machine with content in it's input tanks will fill any fluid barrels, universal tanks or pipettes (if the fluid amount cannot fill any of the previous options).
&6Pipettes&r can be used to input specific amounts of fluids. Right-clicking or Shift-Right-clicking will increase or decrease the fluid amount.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.advanced_: The &dAdvanced Enchantment Table&r gives its user the ability to choose any enchantment they want, at the cost of significantly more experience.
&2Since very low level books are cheap, its a great way of mass producing Pulverized Enchantment for endgame recipes.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.air_intak: The &3Air Intake&r, when powered, produces &bCompressed Air&r needed in &3Pneumatic Pipes&r and &bHot Air Blast&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.ammo_pres: With casting available through the &3Crucible&r, many gun parts can now be created such as &6Barrels&r and &6Grips&r. An &3Ammo Press&r is used to create the various ammunitions guns use.
A &3Weapon Modification Table&r can be used to install weapon mods, such as &6Silencers&r and &6Scopes&r.
The &6Bullet Casing Bag&r will retrieve some of the casings when guns are fired.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.analog_ci: The &6Analog Circuit&r is the first true circuit board used in crafting certain essential machines and tools such as the &6Oil Deposit Detector&r, the &3Chemical Plant&r, and the &3Electric Arc Furnace&r.
&2A cheaper recipe for Capacitors will be available if a Shredder is owned.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.annihilat: The &3Annihilator&r is a machine that destroys items and fluids. Annihilating radioactive items or pollution creating fluids will cause more serious environmental consequences than disposing of them in other manners.
This machine is mainly intended for &2528 Mode&r where disposing of items will unlock blueprints required for progression.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.anvil.des: &3Anvils&r are a tiered crafting station that allows for the creation of various machines, structures, and items in some cases. There are multiple tiers of anvils with greater anvil tier primarily corresponding to a greater quantity of recipes being available.
Plate Stamps, used in the &3Burner Press&r, are made in the anvil. A plate stamp is required for the &3Blast Furnace&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.arc_welde: The &3Arc Welder&r is a machine needed for the creation of many components, such as &6Welded Plates&r, &6Missile Parts&r and more. Some Recipes will require a fluid inserted into the welder to work.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.armor_mod: The &3Armor Modification Table&r allows for armor modifications to be inserted in armor, giving either buffs, new abilities or extra resistance.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.ashpit.de: An &3Ashpit&r can be installed beneath a &3Firebox/Heating Oven&r or &3Smokestack&r which will collect &6Ash&r, that can be used as a cheap black dye alternative aswell as in the creation of &6Industrial Fertilizer&r.
&6Coal Ash&r can later be centrifuged to obtain some &6Boron&r.
An Ashpit below an &3Industrial Smokestack&r will produce &6Fine Soot,&r used in the creation of &6Fullerite&r, a late game material.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.assembly_: The &3Assembly Machine&r is used in every stage of the game, with it being used to manufacture practically every other complex machine. Recipes for it can be chosen inside the GUI.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.automatic: With the &6&3Automatic Buzz Saw&r one can automatically farm trees for their &6Wood&r. If jungle trees are farmed, &6Latex&r automation is also possible.
&3Fans&r, when powered by redstone, can be used to push the dropped items into hoppers or conveyors for storage. Use a &6Drill&r on them to remove the diminishing pushing range.
The &3Automatic Thresher&r harvests crops such as &6Wheat&r, &6Hemp&r, &6Sugarcane&r, ect in a 7x7 area when supplied with fuel. It will eject all items from the back.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.better_fu: The &3Bricked Furnace&r is almost the same as the vanilla furnace, but it can smelt construction materials faster, such as &6Sand&r and &6Cobblestone&r being smelted at double the speed. &6Clay&r and &6Fire Clay&r can be smelted at &e&rquadruple&r the speed, which means that making a full brick block can be done within a vanilla furnace operation. It can also make &6Charcoal&r at double the speed. It can also collect Ashes from burnt fuel.

The &3Iron Furnace&r has the base smelting speed &e20%&r faster than the vanilla furnace, which means it can complete an operation within 8 seconds instead of 10 seconds. Besides being able to smelt faster, it consumes fuel only during operation, so the fuel is never wasted. It also has burn time bonuses for various kinds of fuel, ranging from &e+25%&r for lignite to &e+100%&r for solid fuel.
&dEt Futurum Requiem&r also backports modern furnaces, such as the &3Smoker&r, which cooks food faster, and the &3Blast Furnace&r, which smelts ores faster.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.blast_fur:
The &3Blast Furnace&r is a solid fuel-powered furnace used to create different alloys out of two inputs. The main starter alloys are: &6Minecraft Grade Copper&r and &6Steel&r. Inserting &bHot Air Blast&r, made by putting &bCompressed Air&r in a &3Boiler&r, grants all recipes a &e5x&r boost.
&bFlue Gas&r produced from operating the machine can be burnt for energy or vented into the atmosphere.
The Blast Furnace also comes with more efficient recipes to make &6Firebricks&r, by reducing item cost and skipping the smelting part.
At this stage of the game, the most efficient way of producing steel is by combining &6Iron Ore&r and &6Flux&r, giving 3 steel ingots.
Steel tools come equiped with vein mining, making them an excellent early-game tool.
&2For more advanced tools later on, pressing the ALT key will bring up a menu from which one can select multiple abilities at once.&r
&6Bobmazon&r is an in-game shop where players can spend &6Bottle Caps&r to purchase various items such as building blocks, plants, resources and many more. To purchase items, one must have unlocked the achievements listed below as "Ratings".
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.boiler_an: The &3Boiler&r, when receiving heat from below, heats up fluids. Two important uses of the boiler are for &bSteam&r and &bOil&r processing which will come later on. The Boiler can explode if its output is full.

Steam, when used by machines, such as reactors sending steam through &3Turbines&r or &3Chemical Factories&r produce &bLow-Pressure Steam&r. The low-pressure steam can be recycled back to retrieve 100% of the water by using a &3Steam Condenser&r. Closed water loops are recommended for reactors.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.burner_pr: The &3Presses&r are machines that can be used to make &6Plates&r, &6Wires&r, &6Circuits&r, &6Bullet Casings&r as well as &6Compressing&r non-smeltable powders back into their normal form. They require &6Stamps&r to work, which can be made from an &3Anvil&r.
&2A preheater can be placed next to the Burner Press to increase its speed.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.cast_plat: &6Cast Plates&r are crafted by melting 3 ingots worth of materials in a &3Crucible&r and casting it in a &3Shallow Foundry Basin&r with a cast plate mold.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.charcoal_: &6Wood&r obtained from a tree farm can be smelted or processed in a &3Combination Oven&r to produce &6Charcoal&r, which has many uses, such as fuel for &3Furnaces&r or even the &3Blast Furnace&r, &6Flux&r or &6Carbon&r in a Crucible for &6Steel&r production, or even &6Gunpowder&r for ammunition.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.charging_: The &3Charging Station&r will charge electric tools aswell as electric suits when standing near it. Placing more next to eachother will increase the speed at which items are being recharged.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.charm_of_: The &6Charm of Protection&r diverts meteorites away from the player and prevents them from destoying blocks. It is recommended that one is obtained as soon as possible as to prevent costly damages in the future.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.chemical_: The &3Chemical Plant&r is a machine needed for several processes, turning fluids into other fluids, synthesis of different compounds, ect. Like the &3Assembly Machine&r, recipes can be selected entirely within the GUI.
&6Cladding&r is one of the most important armor modifications which reduce radiation intake. It can be inserted to all armor pieces.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.combinati: The &3Combination Oven&r is a unique type of furnace that transforms items into their respective product and produce liquid byproducts. It can be used to produce &6Coke&r, &bWood Oil&r and &6Aluminium&r more efficiently.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.compresso: The &3Compressor&r is a specialized multiblock machine for compressing fluids. It can perform this operation on any fluid to increase its pressure, for use in other machines. Some of these fluids are compressed into different fluids entirely as special recipes for this machine.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.conveyor_: &3Conveyors&r provide the simplest way of moving items around. There are multiple blocks that can interface with machines as well as items moving along conveyor belts.

&3Conveyor Belts&r are blocks used to transport items. They can pick up dropped items or items from conveyor ejectors. Conveyor inserters can take items from conveyor belts. If there are no conveyor inserters present, the item will be dropped at the end of the conveyor belt line.

&3Conveyor Inserters&r are blocks that take items from conveyor belts and outputs them into a storage space. Conveyor ejectors are the opposite, they take items from storage and place them onto conveyor belts.
Inserters have an option to destroy surplus items if the input buffer has run full, otherwise the items that can neither be inserted in the target nor the inserter's buffer is simply dropped.

The ejector has a whitelist/blacklist system (the default mode is blacklist with no restrictions - this means that everything will go through). Rick-clicking the white arrow will toggle between whitelist and blacklist. An item can be added to the blacklist/whitelist by "depositing" it into the blue inventory square - the item will not be consumed, however.
&2Make sure to visit the NTM: Logistics page for more information.&r
The &3Crucible&r is an important machine as it is the central component of metallurgy. It is used as a method of ore processing, alloying, and metal casting. It requires an external heat source to melt the inputs into liquids and when filled, it emits a consistent amount of soot that can cause a fair amount of pollution that cannot be mitigated. Some alloys, as mentioned before, can be made alternatively using a &3Blast Furnace&r, however this is generally slower.
It is recommended that the wiki is checked out.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.crucible_: &6Hematite&r and &6Malachite&r can be processed in a crucible with Flux to produce &6Iron&r and &6Copper&r respectively.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.dense_wir: &6Dense Wires&r are another crafting component used in many recipes. The first one must be made in a &3Welder&r and the recipe consumes &e10kHE/t&r. After its made, it can be used to make a casting mold for the &3Crucible&r.
&2It is recommended that the recipe is attempted only after good enough energy generation is achieved or a sufficiently large amount of energy storage is obtained.&r
&6Dense Minecraft Grade Wires&r unlock a cheaper and easier way of producing Motors.
&6Dense Gold Wires&r unlock the next tier of &3Capacitors&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.depth_ore: &6Depth Ores&r are large ore deposits found at bedrock level. There are many types of deposits, most of them giving ore crystals which can be smelted for 3 ingots per. &3Mining Charges&r of any kind are required to extract the resources from the depth rock.

Two important resources found in depth deposits are &6Borax&r, which can later be put in an &3Arc Furnace&r or &3Acidizer&r to yield &6Boron&r used in reactors, and &6Zirconium&r which is used in reactor fuel rods.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.drainage_: The &3Drainage Pipe&r allows the dumping of fluids and gasses into the environment at the cost of pollution.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.early_gam: Early Game has a couple of options for power generation which will be needed to power up the first few basic electric machines.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.electrici: For better looking, aswell as longer distance energy transportation, a &l&r&6Cable Drum&r with &3Electricity Connectors&r can be used. These powerlines are non solid and can also pass through floors and walls.
&3Electricity Pylons&r are used to transport power more easily between larger distances. There are two variants, going from 25 blocks per pylon to 45 respectively.
The 45 block pylon variants require the ones with transformers to input and output energy.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.electric_: The &3Electric Furnace&r is a varient of the furnace which uses electricity to smelt items. It also has a slot for upgrades to make it faster later on. It consumes from &e1kHE/s &rwithout upgrades up to &e4kHE/s&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.energy_ca: The most basic block for transmission is the &3Red Copper Cable&r, which comes in two varieties, a block form and a skinnier cable form. The block form also has a paintable version which can help it blend into your designs better.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.energy_st: The &3Battery Socket&r is used to hold &6Batteries&r or &6Capacitors&r.
Batteries have more energy storage, but a slower discharge time, meaning that only a small amount of stored power can be outputted to the grid.
Capacitors on the other hand, have less energy storage, but a faster discharge time.
&2Tools and armor pieces can be charged inside a battery socket if power is supplied.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.flow_cont: The &3Flow Control Pump&r is used to set priorities for fluid pipes aswell as to limit fluid throughput.
&G&6Glyphids&r are large insects that have many different types. They primarily spawn with naturally generated &6&rhives&r structures. All of the types are armored and they take less damage than against normal mobs. Glyphids are normally attracted to pollution created by the player, and usually have to be dealt with by the player.

&6&r&6Hives&r can spawn naturally in all non-ocean biomes and can also be created by glyphid scouts. They contain several glyphid egg blocks and some low-tier loot inside, lying on top of eggs. glyphid egg blocks spawn glyphids and drop glyphid eggs upon destruction.
&2It is recommended that all hives are destroyed as soon as possible as to prevent their spread later on.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.hazmat_su: &6Hazmat Suits&r provide protection against many hazards, mainly radiation. &6Hazmat Cloth&r can be further strengthened to create more resistant hazmat suits.
To provide additional protection against environmental dangers, a &6Gas Mask Filter&r is needed, which can be equiped by right-clicking while holding it.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.heating_o: The &3Firebox&r and the &3Heating Oven&r are machines capable of producing heat (&eTU&r) from solid fuels for any machines that require heat to operate.

Both machines are similar in operation. In order for them to transfer heat, another machine for receiving the heat must be placed on top, such that the copper heat plate on the receiving machine sits on top of the copper heat plate of the heat producing machine.

Once constructed, these machines can be filled with solid fuel, which will burn until either the fuel runs out, or the heat buffer is filled. No fuel will be consumed if its buffer is full — as such, both machines are fairly efficient at conserving fuel.

The primary difference in these two machines lie in their speed: the firebox burns fuel much slower at full efficiency, whilst the heating oven produces five time the heat (but eight times faster). Despite its inefficiency, the heating oven is often preferred for its much higher heat outputs and heat capacity. However, it cannot heat a stirling engine, as its base output (500 TU/t) will automatically over-speed the engine; the heavy stirling engine does not have this issue.

Additionally, the heating oven can receive heat from other heat producing machines placed underneath it: multiple can be stacked for heat-hungry machines like the crucible. The heat received, however, is halved when transferring to the machine above.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.high_spee: &6High-speed steel&r is an advanced and specialized form of standard steel. It used in many recipes, such as the &3Oil Derrick&r and the &3Industrial Mixer&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.industria: The &3Industrial Mixer&r is a machine that is used to mix a fluid with an item and/or another fluid. It can be used instead of a &3Chemical Plant&r for some recipes.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.infinite_: &bWater&r is used in various ways, such as washing, cooling reactors and used in chemical reactions.
&6Infinite Water Barrels&r produce 50mb/t while the heavy variant produces 500mb/t.

&3Water Pumps&r can produce water even faster, the steam version being able to produce 1000mb/t while the electric one up to 10000mb/t. They must be placed under Y:70 and require a 3x3x2 dirt platform beneath them.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.latex.des: &6Latex&r is an early game rubber which can be used instead of normal &6Rubber&r, such as cheaper conveyors. Before the &3Press&r is unlocked, it can be made using dandelions in a crafting table.
&2If a jungle biome is too far away, beach biomes provide jungle wood and saplings from palm trees.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.long_dist: For greater distances, and improved aesthetics, a new distribution node is available, the &3Large Electricity Pylon&r.
&3Substations&r are needed to step up/down the voltage that the line carries.
These Pylons can prove useful as favorable &eBedrock Ore&r or &eOil deposits&r may be located far away from the main base.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.machine_u: The &6Machine Upgrade Template&r is the baseline for all machine upgrades. Machine upgrades are not only used to increase the efficiency of machines but also to unlock new functions.
&2While in the UI of a machine, hover over an upgrade on NEI to see its effects.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.mining_ch: The &3Mining Charge&r is an explosive made with the express purpose of mining, as such it's commonly used to mine depth ores, since it dosen't destroy drops, before getting a pickaxe that can do the same.
It has an explosion radius of about 3 blocks and explodes instantly upon being powered by redstone, while exploding it does no damage to entities.

There are two other variants of this, being the &3Timed Mining Charge&r and the &b&3Semtex Mining Charge&r, they are both timed explosives with the semtex one being stronger than the regular one and having &eFortune 3&r, meanwhile the timed mining charge does not seem to have enhanced capabilities, other than being timed and thus more convinient to use.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.multi_flu: The &6Multi Fluid Identifier&r is used to select the type of fluid one needs. Shift-Click while holding it to select a fluid. To apply the fluid id simply right-click on a pipe. Shift and right-clicking will apply the fluid id to all connected pipes.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.ntm_intro: This is the begining of the tech tree of &dHBM's Nuclear Tech Mod&r. Before proceeding it is recommended that you stock up on materials such as &6Iron&r, &6Coal&r, &6Copper&r and &6Redstone&r.

&a&2Some advanced machinery can be obtained by salvaging them from structures scattered across the world, such as Centrifuges from abandoned nuclear powerplants found in deserts, or by rare mob drops such as a Geiger Counter.&r
Most of the information in this quest book was derived from the official NTM wiki and Qmaw entries, with additional information being added.
The NTM Wiki link can be found here:
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.oil_resev: The &6Oil Resevoir Detector&r will help one in the search for an &eOil Deposit&r by pointing it out at the top left of the screen.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.pipe_anch: &3Pipe Anchors&r are non solid fluid ducts which can be used instead of normal ducts.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.player_de: The &3Player Decontaminator&r will remove Rads received while standing on it. It can be very cost efficient, as other methods such as &6RadAways&r require constant replenishment.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.pneumatic: &3Pneumatic Pipes&r are an instant form of item transportation which can cover large distances. The pipes must have &bCompressed Pressurised Air&r, which can be created from taking compressed air from an &3Air Intake&r and compressing it in a &3Compressor.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.pollution: The &6Pollution Detector&r will monitor and show the levels of pollution present in the environment. High levels of pollution will decrease the visibility, give debuffs to the player and buff mobs, including skeletons spawning with firearms.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.rock_mill: The &3Rock Mill&r is an early game material grinding machine which grinds down stones into finer items while producing additional byproducts, such as &6Boron&r, &6Niobium&r and &6Titanium&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.rotary_fu: The &3Rotary Furnace&r is a large furnace which is powered by both &bSteam&r and &6&rsolid fuel. &rIt outputs molten material which can be cast similarly to the outputs of the &3Crucible&r and &3Arc Furnace&r. The Rotary Furnace is the only machine that can produce &6Saturnite&r and &6Weapon Steel&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.servo_set: The &6Servo Set&r is an armor modification which grants various buffs, such as &eHaste&r, &eStrength&r, &eSpeed&r and &eJump Boost&r. It can be equiped both for the chestplate and leggings.
It can later be upgraded with &6Desh&r to further boost its buffs.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.settings_: The &6Settings Tool&r is used to copy settings of machines. It is especially useful when making large refineries.
The &3Shredder&r is a machine that shreds resources into their powder form, or in many cases, their crafting materials. It can also be used to double ores.
&6Flour&r can also be made by shredding &6Wheat&r at a 1:1 ratio, which can be then smelted into bread for 3 times the bread from the same amount of wheat.
&2Shredder blades are require in order for the machine to work.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.smokestac: The &3Smokestack&r is used to reduce pollution made from machines. &3Exhaust Pipes&r, made in anvils, can be used to transport the fumes to the Smokestack. The &3Industrial Smokestack&r is needed to produce &6Fine Soot&r, required for making &6Fullerite&r in the late game.
The wiki page for pollution can be found below.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.solar_tow: The &3Solar Tower Boiler&r is an early game machine that can use sunlight from heliostat mirrors to boil water.

The Solar Tower Boiler gets heat from heliostat mirrors pointed at it. Aiming a mirror at the boiler can be done using the mirror adjustment tool, right-click on the boiler will save its position to the tool, and subsequently clicking on mirrors will aim them at the linked boiler. The maximum range for mirrors is 25 blocks, mirror efficiency does not degrade with range. A boiler consumes 1mB of water for every 12.5 mirrors each tick at full sunlight level, and 100mB of steam per mB of water consumed. However, the water consumption rate is rounded down to the millibucket. Thus it takes 13 mirrors to raise your first 100mB/t of steam, 12 mirrors for the next hundred, then 13, 12, and so on.

As the heat provided by each mirror is based on sunlight, mirrors with solid blocks above them will not work, and the amount of heat diminishes with the amount of light in the evening until it produces no heat at night.
The solar tower boiler can only produce regular steam, and thus the liquid type cannot be changed using fluid identifiers.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.soldering: The &3Soldering Station&r is the machine in which &6&rcircuit components&r can be combined&6&r into &6Circuits&r and where &6Machine Upgrades&r can be created.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.steam_eng: The &3Steam Engine&r is an early game method of turning &bSteam&r into energy. It requires an external source to provide steam and a way to dump or reprocess the &bLow-Pressure Steam&r it produces.

The Steam Engine has an energy efficiency of &e85%&r, making it better than the &3Stirling Engine&r. However, it still has a throughput limit as it can only hold up to 2000 mB of steam. Its maximum processing rate is 2000 mB/t, producing a considerable &e3400 HE/t&r or &e68 kHE/s&r. It is therefore the best generator available before &3Steam Turbines&r.
A boiler being heated up by a heating oven using coal will produce &e17kHE/s&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.steel_anv: An upgraded version of the &3Anvil&r, [T2], which unlocks additional recipes.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.steel_fur: The &3Steel Furnace&r, unlike the other furnaces, runs off of &eTU&r. It can also process up to 3 items at a time, but each slot consumes more TU, which makes it slow without a strong heat source. It also has a bonus output for ores and wood, where every smelted item gives &e25%&r to the bonus output meter, which means every 4 items give an extra 5th item for free (&e+15 items from a single stack&r).
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.stirling_: The &3Stirling Engine&r uses heat from a &3Heating Oven&r or a &3&r&3Firebox&r to produce power. If a Heating Oven is used to heat a Stirling engine, it will likely over-speed and damage it, sending the main gear flying. The heavy Stirling engine does not have this issue.
A firebox running on coal with a stirling engine produces &e2kHE/s&r, while a heating oven with a heavy stirling engine produces &e10kHE/s&r.

The &3Stirling Sawmill&r uses heat to cut wooden related items, producing &6Sawdust&r in the process. Sawdust can be used to obtain &6Paper&r, and if further processed, can be turned into &6Charcoal&r in a &3Combination Oven&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.strand_ca: The &3Strand Caster&r is a large basin that can cast items in batches of 9. It also requires &bWater&r in order to cast, where it makes &bLow-Pressure Steam&r that can be turned back into water.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.structure: The &6Screwdriver&r is used to rotate conveyor blocks aswell as to create a &3Chicago Pile&r. It can also be used in combination with &6Bobby Pins&r to unlock &6Safes&r found in various structures.
The &6Crowbar&r is used to open crates for loot such as food and ammunition found in various structures.
&6Uranium-238&r can be found in structures and can be used to skip the &3Desh Anvil&r after obtaining a &3Crucible&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.tanks_and: &3Tanks&r and &3Barrels&r are useful storage devices that can hold various fluids in various amounts. Each tank and barrel supports holding different types of corrosive, hot, or exotic fluids, and knowing which ones can hold your desired fluids can be vital to your fluid processing and storage facilities.
Tanks can hold up to 256,000mb of fluids, while a Steel Barrel can hold 16,000.
&4&2Tanks cant hold highly Antimatter and Corrosive fluids and as such a Big-Ass Tank 9000 or a Magnetic Tank is needed respectively.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.the_end.d: &eThe End&r is entirely optional for &dNTM&r progression, but is home to &6Trixite&r, a unique extraterrestrial mineral that when processed can yield &6Plutonium&r, &6Cobalt&r and &6Niobium&r. The Niobium is of great interest as it is a great source for early &3Catalytic Cracking Towers&r.
Due to only the main end island existing, Trixite Ore is a limited resource.&r Trixite Crystals can also be obtained from an &6Asteroid Mining Ship&r, but it is not recommended.
&dEt Futurum Requiem&r backports many modern end features, such as &eChorus Fruit&r and a respawnable &eEnder Dragon&r using &6End Crystals&r.
The &6Dragon Egg&r can also be used to create a Backpack which provides passive &eNight Vision&r, &eStrength 2&r and &eFire resistance&r, aswell as some &eRegeneration&r when on low health.
Enderman farms can also be made using &3Fans&r to push the endermen into the killing zone.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.the_nethe: &eThe Nether&r is entirely optional for &dNTM&r progression, but is home to many resources, such as:
&6Infernal Coal&r which can be shredded for &6Coal Powder&r. A mask or suit that can protect against Carbon Dioxide is needed to mine the deposits.
&6Glowstone&r for early &bChlorine Gas&r in a &3Combination Oven&r.
&6Cobalt&r can also be rarely found near the Nether Roof.
The Nether has a backround radiation of &e0.1RAD/s&r.&r
&2Glowstone, Quartz and Phosphorus Bedrock Ore Deposits also exist.&r
&2Depth Neodymium Deposits also spawn exclusively in the Nether.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.trench_ma: The &6Trench Mask&r is a basic mask that will protect the user from some dangerous airborne particles while mining. To craft one you must first obtain &6Cloth&r and then piss on it by right clicking while holding it.
&2String can be easily obtained by harvesting Hemp, found in the wild.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.tungsten_: &6Tungsten Reachers&r are a utility item which, when in any slot of the inventory, reduce the radiation taken from items. They can also handle pyrophoric items.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.waystones: &dWaystones&r are a method of teleporation that work in one dimension. They can be set to global to make them accessable by othe players. Additionally, the &dWarpstone&r can be used to teleport to any waystone from anywhere at the cost of a 100s cooldown.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_early_game.wood_burn: The &3Wood-Burning Generator&r is basic method of producing energy by burning wood. It can run on any burnable items but provides burn time bonuses to logs and wood. It can also run on any flammable fuel by clicking on the arrow below the on/off switch, but it is considerably more inefficient than other fluid burning generators.
Burning logs in the generator produces &e2kHE/s.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.aluminium_proces: &7&6Bauxide&r and &6Cryolite&r from the light metal line of Bedrock Ore Processing can be further processed to obtain &6Aluminium&r, with additional byproducts of &6Iron&r, &6Titanium&r and &bMercury&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.antimatter.title: Antimatter
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.antimatter.descr: &bAntimatter&r is a dangerous substance which can be obtained from a &3Cyclotron&r or a &3Particle Accelerator&r. If dropped on the floor a violent explosion will occur. Antimatter cant be stored in normal tanks, and as such, a &3Magnetic Antimatter Container&r is required.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.auxilary_cooling: The &3Auxiliary Cooling Tower&r is a larger version of the Steam Condenser able to process up to 50 mb/t of &bLow-Pressure Steam&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.bakelite.title: Bakelite
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.bakelite.descrip: &6Bakelite&r is an alternative to Polymer and can be used for the same recipes. Since it doesnt require any &6Coal Powder&r or &6Fluorite&r to be made, it is easier and more convenient to automate than &6Polymer&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.balefire.title: Balefire
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.balefire.descrip: &6Balefire&r is an extremely radioactive substance which can be used to make powerful fuels for the &3RBMK&r, aswell as &bBF Rocket Fuel&r for power production. High radiation resistant equipment is needed to hold the item. &6Thermonuclear Ashes&r can be produced sustainably as a byproduct from &bAntimatter - BF Rocket Fuel&r.
The High-Tech Bomb Defusing Device can extract balefire shards from duds.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.basic_oil_proces: Before &bCrude Oil&r can be processed, it must be heated up in a &3Boiler&r.
The &3Oil Refinery&r splits Hot Crude Oil(or later on &bCracked&r) into four different fluid products and one solid byproduct.

After that, those fluids can be sent through a &3Fractioning Tower&r to obtain different kinds of fuels, such as &bKerosene&r and &bDiesel&r. A &3Fractioning Tower Seperator&r can be used to stack fractioning towers ontop of eachother.
It is recommended that the wiki is checked out.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.bedrock_ore_extr: &eBedrock Ore Deposits&r are an infinite source of resources which can be obtained by using a &3Large Mining Drill&r and a &3Bedrock Ore Processor&r. Operating the drill will consume&e 200kHE/s&r.
Before excavation can happen, the &eDepth Rock&r covering the bedrock ore deposit needs to be removed. An easy way of doing that is blowing up the rock with &6Mining Charges&r.

The large mining drill is used to excavate &6Raw Bedrock Ores&r from their deposits. The drill requires a &6Drillbit&r to work&r, which can be upgraded to increase the speed at which it operates at. &eFortune&r on a drillbit affects the quality of mined bedrock ore, each level of fortune adds &e10%&r of the value to the item.

The bedrock ore processor takes &6&rraw bedrock ore obtained from the drill and breaks it down into smaller pieces, each with different products that can be obtained from them. 
&a&bOre Slop&r, which is created when the machine is operating, can be processed into many useful products, especially when it is sent through an &3Electrolysis Machine&r.
The &6Bedrock Ore Density Scanner&r shows information on the composition of Bedrock Ore deposits.
Bedrock ore processing can be both an energy and resource expensive operation so it is recommended that it is explored after having good infrastructure.

&2Consider adding a Power Saving Upgrade to the drill as it only reduces power without affecting the mining speed. Additionally, installing an Effectiveness Upgrade on the ore slopper will make it give out more resources.&r
Make sure to go to the bedrock ore processing chapter and follow the quests there for instructions. It is also recommended that the wiki is checked out.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.catalytic_cracki: The &3Catalytic Cracking Tower&r is a large oil processing multiblock machine which produces many fluids, such as &bAromatic Hydrocarbons&r used for &6Bakelite&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.centrifuge.title: Centrifuge
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.centrifuge.descr: The &6&3Centrifuge&r allows for the seperation of ores, giving back more items than the usual mining method. It also seperates items into their respective items. Additionally, they are used in processing &e&6Bedrock Ores&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.coker_unit.title: Coker Unit
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.coker_unit.descr: The &3Coker Unit&r is a machine that turns oil products into &6Petroleum Coke&r, which is the same to the other kinds of coke, aswell as additional fluids as byproducts. The coker unit will require an external heat source in order to function, similar to the &3Crucible&r.

&2&r&2Alongside the &2&r&2&r&2Electric Arc Furnace, the coker unit is one of the most polluting machines of the mod. It spreads 20 soot per second, making it a dangerous machine to use next to a glyphid nest.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.cyclotron.title: Cyclotron
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.cyclotron.descri: The &3Cyclotron&r is a machine that bombards element powders with element boxes to get heavier elements. Operating the machine will consume&e 20MHE/s&r.
It can also create &bAntimatter&r as a byproduct for certain operations, which makes it a reliable but expensive method of large-scale advanced material production.
&2Consider installing the highest level of Power Saving and Speed upgrades to reduce both recipe time and power consumption.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.derrick.title: Derrick
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.derrick.descript: The &3Oil Derrick&r extracts &bCrude Oil&r and &6&bNatural Gas&r from &eOil Deposits&r that are directly below them. When supplied with power, it will begin to drill downwards until it cannot drill further or reach an oil deposit. Upon reaching a deposit, it will continuously extract oil and gas from it until the deposit is entirely depleted.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.desh.title: Desh
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.desh.description: &6Desh&r is an alloy made up of 9 rare earth metals to make its blend form, which is solidified and refined using &bMercury&r and &bLight oil&r in the &3Chemical Plant&r. Desh is an almost unbreakable material and as such its tools have infinite durability.
The most efficient way of obtaining &6Desh Blend&r is to place rare earth in a &3Shredder&r.
&a&2Desh can also be made using DeshReady™ in a Rotary Furnace, or later on, in an Ore Acidizer.&r
Mercury at this stage of the game can be obtained from centrifuging &eRedstone Ore&r or putting &eCinnabar&r in a &3Combination Oven&r. Large cinnabar veins can be found as depth ore.
Later on, mercury can be obtained from processing &bOre Slop&r or &bVitriol&r in an &3Electrolyzer&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.desh_anvil.title: Desh Anvil
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.desh_anvil.descr: An upgraded version of the &3Anvil&r, [T3], which unlocks additional recipes. Important unlocks of this tier are plates being able to be crafted in the anvil.
Alternatively, the &3Desh Anvil&r can be skipped by making a &3Ferrouranium Anvil&r, [T4], from scavanged &e&r&6Uranium-238&r found in structures.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.electric_arc_fur: The &3Electric Arc Furnace&r is a large automated furnace multiblock machine that can fill the role of &3Crucible&r and automated smelter, and is required for progression as it is the only machine that can produce &6Silicon&r from various sources, such as &6Sand&r, &6Flint&r, &6fiberglass&r, and &6Asbestos&r.

To operate this machine, it will require both electrical power and crafted &7&6Electrodes&r. In terms of electricity, the machine has a maximum storage capacity of &e2.5MHE&r, and consumes &e20kHE/s&r in operation, making it reasonably power hungry. In terms of the electrodes required for operation, there are four types available, and the machine must have three installed before it can operate.

This machine can operate in two different modes: Solid mode, which is the easiest to setup and use, great for initial crafting, and Liquid mode, which produces castable molten ores much like the crucible, with a small bonus to output, increasing efficiency of extraction from various ores.
The &3Electric Heater&r is a heater which produces heat using electricity. A Screwdriver is needed to increase its energy input, to a maximum of &e5023HE/t&r for &e1000TU/t&r.
&2A single Heating Oven that uses Coal produces the same amount of heat so it is not recomended that this is used.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.electric_press.d: The &3Electric Press&r is a version of the &3Burner Press&r which runs on electricity. It also has upgrade slots inside it.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.electric_tools.d: The &6Impact Drill&r is an electric pickaxe which has prebuilt enchantments and abilities on it. It is a very useful tool which will make mining way more efficient.
Similar electric tools exist for the axe and shovel.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.electrolysis_mac: The &3Electrolysis Machine&r enables the separating of elements from fluids and the advanced processing of ores, making it an important machine in ore processing. Operating the machine consumes &e200kHE/s&r.
The electrolysis machine has 2 functions: one for the separation of fluids and one for ore processing.
In the first mode, the machine will take in a compatible fluid and separate it into 2 other fluids.

In the second mode, it will require &bNitric Acid&r and will process any kind of ore-derived crystal, allowing the maximum yield of the ore. There are 2 outputs, for the molten main product the outlet marked green and the secondary the one marked red, plus a byproduct kept in its item form. The outlets follow the same mechanics as the &3Crucible&..&r
&2Consider installing a Power Saving upgrade above level 2 on the electrolysis machine as it will significantly reduce the power consumption with only a minimal speed penalty.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.fiberglass.title: Fiberglass
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.fiberglass.descr: Sand in an &3Ore Acidizer&r can be turned into &6Fiberglass&r, which provides more than &e4x&r the amount of &6Silicon&r in an &3Arc Furnace&r. Additionally, it provides a great recipe for insulators.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.geiger_counter.d: The &6Geiger counter&r is a device used to measure &eRAD/s&r, in order to inform the player of any eventual radiation. It is an upgrade to the &6Dosimeter&r. It can measure three different types of radiation, those types being chunk radiation, environmental radiation and player contamination.
It can be used in one of two forms, either as a hand-held item or in its block form.
Holding it in the inventory will show a meter on the bottom left of the screen, and right clicking while holding it will send a message in chat showing the various doses of radiation.
It will also click whenever it reads any kind of radiation, a signature function of any dosimeter.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.geothermal_heat_: The &3Geothermal Heat Exchanger&r is a machine that uses the heat from &bLava&r, &bVolcanic Lava&r, or geothermal vents below it to heat up anything a normal boiler can, such as &bWater&r, and &bOil&r.

It operates on a 15x15x10 box below it, centered right under the middle of the machine. Every "hot block" in its operational area contributes some heat to the exchanger, and if at least one geothermal vent is present, the total heat output is tripled. Only 3 blocks are hot enough to contribute heat to the heat exchanger:

Lava (source or flowing blocks): &e5 TU&r
Volcanic lava: &e150 TU&r
Geothermal vents: &e300 TU&r (effectively always 900)

The most optimal way to run the geothermal heat exchanger is to place it at Y level 9, above a geothermal vent, and then filling in the rest of its operational range with lava. Given that the average bedrock ore vein contains around 5 bedrock ore blocks, the geothermal heat exchanger can theoretically generate 34,875TU, but in practice the thermal output varies because the geothermal vents can generate volcanic lava passively, which could raise or lower the total heat if the volcanic lava solidifies into basalt.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.hydraulic_fracki: The &3Hydraulic Fracking Tower&r is used to extract infinite oil from a &eBedrock Oil Deposit&r. To operate, the machine needs &bFracking Solution&r. During its operation, the surrounding environment will sustain considerable damage. &6Oily Dirt&r and &6Oily Sand&r can be used to create &6Arsenic&r, a substitute of &6Bismuth&r.
Operating the hydraulic fracking tower will consume &e100kHE/s&r.
&2Fracking Solution made from Sulfuric Acid doubles the efficiency of the Sulfur used.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.ilmenite.title: Ilmenite
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.ilmenite.descrip: &6Ilmenite&r is produced from centrifuging &6Titanium Ore&r. By itself, it can be placed in an Arc Furnace to produce 3 Titanium ingots, or, can be further processed in a Chemical Plant using &bTitanium Tetrachloride&r to further increase its yield. The most efficient recipe is in the &3Pyrolysis Oven&r, where on top of giving the most titanium per ilmenite, it also recycles back all the &bChlorine&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.industrial_boile: The &3Industrial Boiler&r is an upgraded version of the Boiler which has a higher capacity of held liquid. Additionally, it doesnt explode.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.industrial_liqui: The &3Industrial Liquification Machine&r is a general use machine for the liquifying various items. It becomes very useful for cobblestone generation, and thus &6Silicon&r automation.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.industrial_solid: The &3Industrial Solidification Machine&r is a general use machine for the solidification of various fluids.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.industrial_steam: The &3Industrial Steam Turbine&r is a multiblock machine that is a more powerful version of the &3Steam Engine&r. It has an efficiency of &e100%&r and energy output slowly ramps up as &bSteam&r is supplied and slowly goes down as steam cuts out. Additionally, it can process more dense versions of steam for more powerful reactor designs. It can process up to &e6MHE/s&r on normal steam.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.integrated_circu: The &6Integrated Circuit Board&r is the first circuit board to use &6Silicon&r, being used extensively in mid game machines, automation devices, missiles, and various small tools such as the &6Geiger Counter&r.
&2If a Blueprint is found, the circuit can be manufactured using Rubber.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.jetpack.title: Jetpack
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.jetpack.descript: The &6Jetpack&r can be used to travel upwards. It can be upgraded to unlock additional abilities, and can be equiped as an armor modification.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.launch_pad.title: Launch Pad
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.launch_pad.descr: The &3Launch Pad&r is the main launch table for most missiles. Although it is the earliest available, missiles must first be erected before launch, resulting in a small delay.

The &3Silo Launch Pad&r is a miniaturized version of the launch pad. It can launch every generic missile with a delay of only 5 seconds. A rusted variant can be found in the naturally-occurring silo structure, holding the damaged Doomsday Missile.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.m1tty_environmen: The &6M1TTY Environment Suit&r is a cheap electric armor set that comes with many abilities. It is an excellent armor set for exploring as it comes with very high speed buffs aswell as fast swimming speed.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.malachite_proces: Washing &6Malachite&r with &bSulfuric Acid&r will yield &6Copper Scraps&r worth 1 ingot, making it an easy way of obtaining large amounts of copper before &eBedrock Ore Processing&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.microchip.title: Microchip
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.microchip.descri: &6Microchips&r are one of the most important components of future circuits and will be used in bulk throughout progression.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.military_grade_c: The &6Military Grade Circuit Board&r is an advanced Circuit Board used in more complicated machines, such as the &3Gas Centrifuge&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.mining_laser.des: The &3Mining Laser&r is a laser drill which can be used to quickly dig large areas. It has a &e100MHE&r internal power buffer and a 64,000mB internal &bCrude Oil&r buffer. Its default radius is 3, which can be increased by the use of an effectiveness upgrade. It can also be equiped with various upgrades to unlock new functions such as shredding or voiding.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.ore_acidizer.des: The &3Ore Acidizer&r is a useful machine, used for processing various items for utility, ore multiplication, and more. It is powered by electricity and requires various solvents depending on the item. The acidizer is quite the power hungry machine, consuming &e20kHE/s&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.polymer.title: Polymer
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.polymer.descript: &6Polymer&r is a basic plastic material needed for many recipes. Important early uses of it are the &3Centrifuge&r and the &3Electric Arc Furnace&r.
&2Polymer can be skipped if one decides to make bakelite instead through further oil processing.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.powered_drill.de: The &6Powered Drill&r is a modular mining device which can make resource gathering and excavation much faster than normal pickaxes.
Various modifications can be attached in the &3Weapon Modification Table&r, such as new drillbits for a larger mining radious or even new engines, which let it run on electricity.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.precision_assemb: The &3Precision Assembler&r is a machine which can produce &6Blueprints&r. Due to the recipes having a low success rate, automation of the ingredients is recommended.
Pufferfish can be obtained from throwing &6Fishing Dynamite&r in water.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.pumpjack.title: Pumpjack
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.pumpjack.descrip: The &3Pumpjack&r is a more efficient &3Oil Derrick&r which extracts 750mb of &bCrude Oil&r and a random amount of &bNatural Gas&r between 50 and 250mb in a 1.25 second cycle. It depletes a single block of a deposit after extracting a random number of cycles of oil that is on average twice as large compared to the derrick.
In total, this means that the pumpjack is on average 3x as efficient at extracting oil and 3x as fast at doing so while producing the same amount of natural gas as the derrick.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.refinery_power.d: Oil products can be combusted or burnt to produce massive amounts of energy.

The &3Industrial Combustion Engine&r combusts fuels, such as &bHeating Oil&r or &bDiesel&r to produce power. Various piston sets exist, which are needed for the engine to work, each one giving its own efficiency bonuses to fuel grades.
The &4&3Turbofan&r is the best place to use aviation type fuels, such as &bKerosene&r, as it provides &e100%&r power efficiency. Be careful not to stand infront of it while its operational!
The &3Combined Cycle Gas Turbine&r is the only generator that can burn gaseous fuels at &e100%&r efficiency. The CCGT uses &3&bEngine Lubricant&r, and produces &bDense Steam&r.
The &3Flare Stack&r is used for burning gasses such as &bUnsaturated Hydrocarbons&r for power, aswell as dealing with excess fluids.
The &3Fluid Burner&r is a much more efficient way of producing power from gases. Place a &3Boiler&r ontop and run the &bSteam&r through a turbine to generate power.
Consider installing a &6Muffler&r on some of these machines as they are very loud. Shift-Click on a machine while holding a Muffler to apply.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.rubber.title: Rubber
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.rubber.descripti: &6Rubber&r is an essential material used in many crafting recipes. It is created in a &3Chemical Plant&r with &bUnsaturated Hydrocarbons&r obtained from a &3Catalytic Cracking Tower&r.
&6Latex&r is a rubber alternative which can be used in some recipes instead of normal rubber. It can be created early on using a &3Burner Press&r by processing dandelions or jungle wood.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.survey_scanner.d: The &6Survey Scanner&r is a handheld device that will point out underground resource deposits, such as &eDepth Rock&r and &eBedrock Ores&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.tantalum.title: Tantalum
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.tantalum.descrip: &6Tantalum&r is a material needed for the creation of some items, most importantly &6Capacitor Boards&r. Tantalum Polycrystal production requires &6Coltan&r which can be located by the use of a &6Coltass&r. It points to the center of a large area where coltan ore can spawn. Tantalum can be obtained from using &bHigh-Performance Solvent&r on &eHeavy Metal Bedrock Ore&r.
&2Coltan Processing at its early stage can provide Niobium needed for Catalytic Cracking Towers.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.teleporter.title: Teleporter
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.teleporter.descr: The &3Teleporter&r can be used to teleport players, and entities in general, to a specific location.
Right-click a block with the &6Telelinker&r to set the desired exit position, then shift-click the teleporter with the telelinker to configure the teleporter.
&2The teleporter is a one way trip so it is advised that multiple are made.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.transport_drones: &3Transport Drones&r are flying machines which will transport items and fluids between different containers. The drones require no power, and can transport both up and down. &3Waypoints&r can be used to make a better path for the transport drones to move around.
<c value=#ff5555>Drones are currently buggy and are not recommended.</c>
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_oil.weapon_steel.des: &6Weapon steel&r is a steel alloy made by further refining steel in a &3Rotary Furnace&r. As its name implies, it is used in the crafting of weapons and ammunition. It is the next tier of weapons grade alloy after &6Gunmetal&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.advanced_oil: The &3Catalytic Reformer&r is an optional late-game oil processing machine. It converts certain oil products into more valuable ones.
The &3Hydrotreater&r is another optional late-game oil processing machine that allows for easier production of &bSour Gas&r, which can also turn &bCrude Oil&r into &bDesulfurized crude Oil&r.
&2The Hydrotreater requires pressurized Liquid Hydrogen in all its recipes, requiring the use of a Compressor.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.arsenic.desc: &6Arsenic&r is a substitute of &6Bismuth&r which can be made from acidizing &6Oily Dirt&r, found near &ebedrock oil deposits&r or from the environmental damage the &3Fracking Tower&r does, with &bHigh-Performance Solvent&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.big_ass_tank: The &3Big-Ass Tank&r is the largest fluid storage container, capable of storing 16000000mB of fluids, aswell as being able to hold strongly corrosive fluids.
&2Must be placed on solid ground or else it will tilt.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.bismuth.desc: &6Bismuth&r is an important material needed in many advanced crafting recipes. Bismuth can be obtained from either &3RBMK&r fuel depletion and processing though a &3FEL&r and &3SILEX&r, or from bedrock ore processing using &bHigh-Performance Solvent&r.
&6Arsenic&r will require an additional &bOre Acidizer&r aswell as access to high-performance solvent.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.btx.title: BTX
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.btx.descript: &bBTX&r is a high-grade powerful fuel which generates a lot of power when burnt. An important use of BTX is in the creation of &6Crystalline Fullerite&r and &6Hard Plastic Bars&r. BTX can be obtained from a &3Hydrotreater&r, but it is more efficient to use &bReformate&r from a &3Vacuum Refinery&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.cadmium.desc: &6Cadmium&r is a material needed to make &6Cadmium Stee&rl, which is a substitute of &6Technetium Steel&r.
Cadmium can be obtained by smelting cadmium powder, which can be obtained acidizing 10 &6Mustard Willow leaves&r with 250mB of &bHigh-Perfomance Solvent&r in the &3Ore Acidizer&r.
The mustard willow is a plant that can be found near &eBedrock Oil Deposits&r. When it's fully matured, the main item can be obtained, that being the mustard willow leaf.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.chicago_pile: The &3Chicago Pile&r is a low-tech reactor used for breeding nuclear materials, such as &6Plutonium-239&r and &6Reactor Grade Plutonium&r.

The Pile is constructed out of Chicago Pile Graphite Bricks, with a minimum size of 5x5 and a maximum of 15x15. The box does not need to be a perfect cube, so shapes like 5x7x9 are valid as long as the shape is filled.
To assemble it, right-click with a &6Hand Drill&r. Using the hand drill on other sides will create holes needed for the various mechanisms of the reactor.

The front side of the reactor houses the fuel inputs, and at the opposite side the fuel outputs. On the other sides of the reactor is where air inlets are created, which need to be supplied with &bCompressed Air&r at &e1PU&r. Drilling at the top of the reactor creates control rods which are useful for more precise fuel breeding. It is important to mention that none of the above mechanisms can intersect with eachother.
Chicago Pile &3Fuel Loaders&r, &3Vents&r and &3Control Rods&r can be controlled using Redstone-Over-Radio for automation purposes.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.cooling_towe: The &3Cooling Tower&r is a larger version of the &3Auxiliary Cooling Tower&r&r, able to process up to 500 mB/t of &bLow-Pressure Steam&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.crystalline_: &6Crystalline Fullerite&r is an material which is primarely used in endgame machines, such as the &3ICF&r and the &3FEnSU&r.
&2It is recommended that an Effectiveness 3 upgrade is installed on the Acidizer to increase the chance of not consuming the Fullerene, as fullerite can be expensive to produce large quantities.
&6Desh Stamps&r have infinite durability, perfect for automation.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.fel_and_sile: The &3FEL&r or Free Electron Laser is a large multiblock utilized with the SILEX to produce various laser wavelengths needed for all SILEX recipes.
A single FEL can power up to 5 SILEX'es. In order to stop the laser any concrete block can be in the its path.
The lower the wavelength of the crystal, the faster recipes will be completed.

The &6&3SILEX&r is a machine that separates isotopes and elements from compounds or other materials via the SILEX (Separation of Isotopes by Laser Exitation) process. It allows for easier enrichment of &6Uranium&r, &6Plutonium&r, and &6Australium&r.

The SILEX can also process &6Lapis Lazuli&r into &6Sulfur&r, &6Aluminium&r, and most importantly &6Cobalt&r. It can use &bHydrogen Peroxide&r to liquify any material to be processed, the material may even be in a powder state. The processed items come out into the right side collection of slots.
The SILEX must be placed at least 2 blocks away from activated FEL laser, or else its going to melt.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.ferrouranium: An upgraded version of the &3Anvil&r, [T4], which unlocks additional recipes. Important unlocks of this tier are wires being able to be crafted in the anvil.
&2For quests that need the Desh Anvil simply hold the Ferrouranium Anvil in your hand press Detect/Submit on the Desh Anvil quest to complete it.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.fissile_mate: With fissile materials obtained from either &3Gas Centrifuges&r or nuclear fuel processing, nuclear bombs are made available.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.gas_centrifu: The &3Gas Centrifuge&r is used to centrifuge &bUranium/Plutonium Hexafluoride&r to obtain enriched fuel for bombs and reactor fuel.

Two gas centrifuges in a row will yield &6Uranium-238&r and &6Uranium Fuel&r used in reactors. The uranium hexafluoride processing line does not consume the &6Sulfur&r and &6Fluorite&r, so loops are recommended.

The &6Gas Centrifuge Overclocking Upgrade&r is needed to obtain &6Uranium-235&r. Four gas centrifuges will have to be placed in a row and the upgrade on the last of them to obtain uranium-235 nuggets.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.hard_plastic: &6Hard Plastic/PVC Bars&r are very durable plastics needed for many late game recipes.
&2Both can be used in the same recipes.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.heat_exchang: Instead of using the &bHot Coolant&r for power, one can use it to make the &3Steel Furnace&r go at ludicrous speeds.

The &4&3Heat Exchanging Heater&r is used to cool down coolants used in reactors while also genearting &eTU&r. A &3Boiler&r can be placed ontop of it to heat up other fluids, such as &bSteam&r, to be used in &3Steam Turbines&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.heavy_magnet: The &3Heavy Magnetic Storage Tank&r is a large version of the &3Magnetic Antimatter Container&r. It will be particularly useful when making &6Gerald&r, as he will need very large quantities of &bStellar Flux&r.
The &6HEV Mark IV&r is a strong electric armor set, with the intent of keeping the user safe primarely from dangerous hazards, such as high levels of radiation, fire, certain air particles and more. The suit comes equiped with an &6Geiger Counter&r and custom hud.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.high_perform: &bHigh-Performance Solvent&r is a solvent which is used in an &3Ore Acidizer&r to further increase the products of bedrock ores, aswell as other recipes. It can be created from &bReformate Gas&r, from a &3Vacuum Refinery&r, and &bChlorine&r in an &3Industrial Mixer&r or be obtained from an &3RBMK&r Irradiation Channel.
To transport High-Performance Solvent by hand, a &6Hazardous Material Tank&r is needed.
&2High-Performance Solvent made from an RBMK irradiation channel requires an ore acidizer.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.high_power_s: The &3High-Power Steam Condenser&r is the a steam condenser which runs on electricity. It processes up to 60 mB/t of &bLow-Pressure Steam&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.large_factor: The &3Chemical Factory&r is a large version of the &3Chemical Plant&r, capable of performing 4 recipes in parallel. It has double the speed of the chemical plant but consumes twice as much power. Additionally, it consumes &bWater&r as a coolant, and produces &bLow-Pressure Steam&r, so a closed water cycle is recommended.
The &3Assembly Factory&r is a large version of the &3Assembly Machine&r, capable of performing 4 recipes in parallel. It functions the same as the chemical factory.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.leviathan_st: The &3Leviathan Steam Turbine&r is a massive turbine capable of processing gargantuan amounts of &bSteam&r at once, only hindered by the fluid system's transfer rate. It is significantly more powerful than even the &3Industrial Steam Turbine&r in terms of raw steam processing power. This turbine runs on &e85%&r Efficiency, so it is recommended that only 1-2 are used for very large reactors.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.liquidator_m: Incase of an &3RBMK&r meltdown, &6Fuel Chunks&r will be thrown near the reactor. The &6Liquidator Medal&r is an armor modification which passively reduces radiation, making it very useful when handling radioactive items or venturing into irradiated areas.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.nuclear_bomb: With access to &6Tantalum&r for &6Control Units&r and fissile matterials, it is possible to assemble a nuclear bomb. To detonate the bomb one can use a detonator or a redstone signal.

A nuclear explosion will transform ores into more valuable ones, such as &6Coal&r to &6Diamonds&r or &6Uranium&r to &6Schrabidium&r. Be prepared with radiation resistant armor before venturing into the crater.
Make sure to stand behind some strong cover if you wish to see the explosion from close by.
&2This quest serves as a list of components needed for various bombs. Some of these components can be mounted onto rockets that will carry the payload over large distances.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.nuclear_fuel: With the &3Spent Fuel Pool Drum&r to cool down &3ZIRNOX&r or &3PWR&r depleted nuclear fuel and the &3PUREX&r to further process them, many new materials are now available.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.nuclear_wast: The &3Nuclear Waste Disposal Drum&r is used to decay &3RBMK&r nuclear waste. The decayed nuclear waste can then be used with a &3FEL&r and &3SILEX&r to obtain some rare elements, such as &6Bismuth&r.
&2The drum also emmits radiation when theres fuel inside it.&r
Later on, the &3Radiation-Powered Engine&r is a more reliable way of decaying rbmk fuel as you get guaranteed consistent decay times. Additionally it also provides power and doesnt emmit radiation.
&2Blueprints can be found in structures, purchased through Bobmazon or made in a Precision Assembler.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.purex.title: PUREX
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.purex.descri: The &3PUREX&r is a machine that can reprocess depleted nuclear fuel into various materials. Most recipes require both &bNitric Acid&r and &bKerosene&r to function.
&6Schrabidium&r can also be extracted from certain recipes, which require &bSchrabidic Acid&r. The schrabidium extracted yields double the schrabidium used to make the acid.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.pwr.title: PWR
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.pwr.descript: The &2&3PWR&r is a modular fission reactor. It is more limited than the &3RBMK&r in terms of capability and fuel types but it is much safer and easier to use due to it melting down more gently and being far more stable in its operation.
Due to the complex and expansive nature of the PWR, it is highly recommend that the wiki is checked out as it provides more information.
&2This quest demands the most essential parts of a PWR, and does not represent the amount needed for a functioning reactor. There are also many other types of PWR Components that can be used.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.pyrolysis_ov: The &3Pyrolysis Oven&r is a mid-to-late game oil processing machine that allows easier production pf &6Crystalline Fullerite&r, which is needed in bulk for late-game machines onwards.

It can process an item with an optional fluid to produce another item and/or fluid. Functionally, it works similar to the &3Combination Oven&r, mostly in bedrock ore processing.
Its main use however is in production of &6Fullerene&r, as it can turn &6Tar&r into &6Fine Soot&r, eliminating the RNG of a &3Smokestack&r.

Operating the pyrolysis oven will consume &e200kHE/s&r.
&2
Consider installing a Power Saving upgrade as it will significantly reduce the power consumption without speed penalty.&. At lvl 3 the power consumption goes down to 50kHE/s.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.rbmk.title: RBMK
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.rbmk.descrip: The &3RBMK&r is a modular boiling-water type nuclear fission reactor which consists entirely of concrete columns. Each of these columns is either blank or has a specific function that it performs such as holding fuel rods, moderating neutrons, or storing &bWater&r to be boiled into &bSteam&r. Each column will also exchange heat with the column next to it such that temperature differences between columns will gradually equalize within the reactor. If any column reaches &e1500°C&r, the reactor will explode incredibly violently, spraying scrap and immensely radioactive material in every direction.
Due to the complex and expansive nature of the RBMK, it is highly recommend that the wiki is checked out as it provides more information.

&2This quest provides an optional retrieval task for a cheap and safe RBMK design which can produce High-Performance Solvent&r &2without cooling. Simply Place the RBMK Irradiation Channel next to the RBMK Fuel Rod, apply the covers on the collumns and surround them with a solid block.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.rbmk_fuel_pr: With the &3Nuclear Waste Disposal Drum&r to decay waste and a &3SILEX&r, &3RBMK&r nuclear fuels can be processed into many new materials.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.red_key.desc: The &6Red Key&r is able to open any container that requires a regular key, regardless of the pin configuration of the lock, and it is one of the only two keys capable of opening the keyhole found on strange stone, in order to open a &eRed Room&r. The key has no durability, and can be reused indefinitely.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.reformate.de: &bReformate&r is a product of &bCrude Oil&r obtained via a &3Vacuum Refinery&r or from processing &bNaptha&r in a &3Hydrotreater&r.
&2This step can be skipped if making Jet Fuel and BTX using a Hydrotreater.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.reformate_ga: &bReformate Gas&r is used in welding very durable materials, aswell as used in making &6Saturnite&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.saturnite.de: &6Saturnite&r is a very durable, heat-resistant and corrosion-resistant alloy that is commonly used for making stronger gun parts. It is also used to make &6Starmetal&r and is an important component of the &3Watz&r reactor.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.spent_fuel_p: The &3Spent Fuel Pool Drum&r is used to cool down hot nuclear fuel rods for the &3RBMK&r, &3ZIRNOX&r and &3PWR&r. It has 12 slots.
The drum needs to have at least one of its sides touching &bWater&r to work. The more sides that have water the faster the fuels inside will cool down.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.starmetal.de: &6Starmetal&r is a unique alloy made from combining &6Saturnite&r with &6Meteorite Powder&r in a &3Blast Furnace&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.starmetal_pi: The &6Starmetal Pickaxe&r is used as a crafting component for the &6Molten&r and &6Bismuth Pickaxes&r, both being unbreakable and having a lot of abilities. Additionally, both can be used to mine &eDepth Rock&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.technetium_9: &6Technetium-99&r is a common waste product from the fission of &6Uranium&r and &6Plutonium&r. It is mainly used in making &6Technetium Steel&r and &dAE2 Storage Components&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.technetium_c: &6Technetium/Cadmium Steel&r is a steel based alloy mixed with technetium-99/Cadmium which has extreme corrosion resistance. It is frequently used in the late-game and acts as one of the main material gates of the &3Fusion&r and &3Watz&r powerplant.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.tungsten_car: &6Tungsten Carbide&r is an alloy made from &6Tungsten&r and &bSyngas&r in a &3Pyrolysis Oven&r. It is mainly used in crafting neutron reflectors for reactors and nukes.
&6Uranium-238&r is the most common uranium isotope in the game.

This material has many uses, some of which are: &6Ferrouranium&r, MOX fuel, depleted uranium ammunition, absorber Pellets for the &3Watz&r powerplant and can also be turned into &6Schrabidium&r later on in the &3Exposure Chamber&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.vacuum_refin: The &3Vacuum Refinery&r is an oil refinery which processes &bPressurized/Desulfurized Crude Oil&r into 4 liquid products. It is a good way to make &bHigh-Performance Solvent&r by using &bReformate Gas&r and &bChlorine Gas&r in an &3Industrial Mixer&r.
&2Compressors are needed for the oil to be inserted inside the Vacuum Refinery.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.versatile_ci: The &6Versatile Circuit Board&r is the final tier of circuit board, requiring &6Bismuth/Arsenic&r and &6Hard Plastic/PVC Bars&r.  As well as this, it is by far the most expensive circuit board, requiring nearly 55 insulators to craft a single one. Used rarely but in small amounts in advanced machines like the &3Fusion Reactor&r and in large amounts in components for the &3ICF Reactor&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.versatile_in: The &6Versatile Integrated Circuit&r is the first circuit to use &6Bismuth/Arsenic&r. It is used in more advanced machines such as the &3Vacuum Refinery&r and is one of the main components of &6Versatile Circuit Boards&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.welded_techn: The &6Welded Technetium/Cadmium Steel Plate&r is the welded varient of the cast technetium/cadmium steel plate and is used in some recipes that require strong materials.
&2Make sure to have good energy generation and storage infrastructure as each plate costs 1.2 Billion HE.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.zirnox.title: ZIRNOX
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fission.zirnox.descr: The &3ZIRNOX&r is the first and cheapest nuclear reactor that one can make. Unlike the &3PWR&r and &3RBMK&r, it is a fully assembled reactor which requires &bWater&r and &bCarbon Dioxide&r to operate.
A ZIRNOX running on &6Natural Uranium Fuel Rods&r, at 14000mb of carbon dioxide and on 3 &3Industrial Turbines&r can produce up to &e285.6kHE/s&r.
&60G Assemblers&r allow for the production of certain items in orbit, mainly the &6Crystal Circuite Board&r. Launching more assemblers will speed up the recipe. The input items must be launched from a rocket.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.additional_fu: The &3Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber&r uses neutron flux from a torus to in order to process materials. It can perform any recipe from an &3RBMK irradiation channel&r, with some additional recipes aswell. The neutron flux is not affected by port sharing rules, and the output level is the same on any side.
The &3Fusion Reactor Collection Chamber&r increases the byproduct production rate by &e50%&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.chlorophyte.d: &6Chlorophyte&r is a product of fusion and is used in the &3DFC&r and &6Digamma Particle&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.cmb_steel.des: &6CMB Steel&r is an alloy made from &6Poisonous Mud&r and &6Magnetized Tunsten&r in a &3Crucible&r. This alloy is used in endgame machinery, such as the &3ICF&r and &3DFC&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.crystal_circu: The &6Crystal Circuit Board&r is an end game circuit used for making &6Gerald&r and the &3DFC&r. The finished item will be received via the &3Cargo Landing Pad&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.deuterium_ext: The &3Deuterium Extractor Tower&r is a much larger version of the Deuterium Extractor, making it an easy and viable way of making cheap fuel for the &b&r&3Fusion Reactor&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.drive_enclosu: Attaching a &3Drive Enclosure&r to one of the ports of a &3Satellite Ground Station&r which is linked to a satellite will allow it to receive data.
&2A linked satellite ground station, when looking at it, will reveal information about the satellite.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.ferric_schrab: &6Ferric Schrabidate&r is an alloy made from &6Iron&r, &6Ionized Particles&r and &6Schrabidium&r.
Flash Drives are inserted into the &3Supercomputer&r and can be made into &eFlight Simulation Data&r, used in making the &6Soyuz&r and &6Orbital Module&r, or &eParticle Simulation Data&r used in the &3Fusion Reactor&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.flight_data.d: One Space Laboratory will produce &eFlight Data&r for &6Disk Drives&r every 15 minutes.
The &3Fusion Reactor Boiler&r is simplest method of extracting power from a fusion reactor, outputting &bSuper Dense Steam&r to be run through normal turbines.

Due to using plasma energy, both the MHDT and the boiler are affected by port sharing rules, meaning that having multiple connected MHTDs, or boilers, decreases the amount of energy each turbine gets, but overall increases the total amount of extracted from the torus.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.fusion_reacto: The &3Fusion Reactor&r is a large, expensive, and advanced reactor type that runs by fusing various plasma types to generate heat.
The main part of the fusion reactor, the &3"Torus"&r, features four connecting ports for external components. It requires electricity and &bPerfluoromethyl&r cooling to operate.

The &3Klystron&r is the main power source of the fusion reactor, which uses electricity and compressed air, to generate input energy, &eKyU&r, for the connected torus. It will throttle if the buffered electricity or compressed air falls below &e50%&r, and if it falls below the torus' required input level, the plasma will extinguish.
