The different plasma types also generate different useful byproducts and differing levels of neutron flux for breeding bulk quantities of materials, such as &6Lithium&r into &6Tritium&r.
Welding the coils will require a &6Blowtorch&r or an &6Acetylene Welding Torch&r.
More information can be found below:
&2For the additional components and power generation methods, please check out the two quests below.&r
&2Multiple fusion reactors will be required soon so it is recommended that Bedrock Ore Processing and Oil Refinement is automated.&r

The &3Fusion Reactor Coupler&r turns outgoing plasma energy from a torus into usable &eKyE&r which can then be used to power another torus. Some fuel combinations require this, as the minimum &eKyE&r energy needed to ignite the plasma exceeds what four &3Klystrons&r could deliver.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.gravity_gun.d: The &6Gravity Gun&r is an advanced tool which can lift and throw blocks. It is particularly useful for moving highly hazardous blocks, such as corium from a reactor meltdown, or throwing explosives.
&2The gravity gun can be supercharged in a Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber, further increasing its range and power.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.helium_4.desc: &bHelium-4&r is a product of fusion and is mainly used in crafting &6Quantum Processing Units&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.ionized_parti: &6Ionized Particles&r are the main product of the &3Fusion Reactor&r and are used in making &6Ferric Scrabidate&r, aswell as some particle capsules needed in the &3Particle Accelerator&r.
&2Ionized Particles can be infinitely produced by utilizing Ionic Gel.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.lamda_rockets: The &6Lamda-98 Rocket&r is a rocket which can be used to launch satellites for cheaper and faster.

The launch pad consumes &e200kHE/s&r constantly and each launch consumes 16000mb of &bLeaded Gasoline&r and &bHydrogen Peroxide&r. The launches can be set to automatic if fuel and materials are supplied.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.magnetized_tu: &6Magnetized Tungsten&r is the product of combining &6Schrabidium&r and &6Tungsten&r in a &3Blast Furnace&r. It can also be rarely dropped by cybercrabs in &eMeteorite Dungeons&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.magnetohydrod:
&3Magnetohydrodynamic Turbines&r are advanced components of the fusion reactor that make electricity out of the plasma energy directly without needing additional turbines. While more expensive and requiring &bPerfluoromethyl&r cooling, they have a &e+35%&r convertion bonus from &eTU&r to &eHE&r. In addition, the MDH turbine requires a minimum input of
&e5MTU/t&r of plasma energy to operate normally, otherwise efficiency will be halved.
Orbital Data is currently only used for making &6Gerald&r. Due the amount it requires, it is highly recommended that a large amount of &6Satellite Sensor Relays&r are launched.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.particle_acce: The &3Particle Accelerator&r is a highly modular machine that uses high strength superconducting magnets to accelerate particles to relativistic speeds in order to collide them together. Make sure to head over to the Particle Physics chapter after completing this quest.

Make sure to visit the Particle Physics quest chapter for more information. Due to the complex and expansive nature of the particle accelerator, it is also highly recommend that the wiki is checked out as it provides more information.
&2This quest demands the most essential parts of the particle accelerator, and does not represent the amount needed for it to function.
The &3Plasma Forge&r is a large and advanced assembler that requires a running fusion reactor to work. It can weld plates at twice the speed of a normal welder. It does not accept upgrades, however, it can use up otherwise useless fission fragments and unstable isotopes to gain a temporary &ex4&r speed bonus with no penalty.
Plasma Forges pass on 75% of the thermal energy, meaning that with a simple Deuterium - Oxygen fusion reactor, up to 4 can be chained for welding purposes.
&2With 3MTU/t plasma energy input, one can make pre-assembled fusion reactors with a discount.&r&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.quantum_proce: The &6Quantum Processing Unit&r is the first quantum circuit one makes, used in the &3Particle Accelerator&r and &3ICF&r reactor.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.satellite_gro: The &3Satellite Ground Station&r is used to send and receive Redstone-Over Radio signals from satellites in orbit.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.satellite_id_: The &3Satellite ID Manager&r is used to assign specific IDs to &6Satellites&r. To assign an id place the satellite in the [?] area.

&2It is highly recommended that the ID of the satellite is copied over in a separate ID chip as to not lose it. To copy an ID simply place the ID chip in the ID slot and the desired satellite next to it.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.schrabidium.d: &6Schrabidium&r is a dangerous material, but one which is needed for the creation of other items, such as &6Magnetized Tungsten&r and &6Ferric Schrabidate&r. It also makes for great reactor fuel. It can be created from exposing uranium ore to radiation using either a nuclear weapon or, more easily, by exploding radioactive barrels found in the abandoned nuclear powerplants in deserts.
&2When holding Schrabidium, the player will receive the blindness effect, so it is recommended that a Suit which provides protection from both Bright Lights and Radiation is used.
The &6Sensor Relay Satellite&r is used to produce &eOrbital Data&r. A single relay takes &e100 hours&r to produce one drive worth of orbital data. It can be sped up by installing more relays. Each additional Relay reduces the time linearly, meaning that a satellite with 100 relays will produce orbital data in just &eone hour&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.solid_mud_bri: &6Poisonous Mud&r is the byproduct of the &3Watz&r operating. This is the solidified version of it which can be used in a &3Crucible&r to create &6CMB Steel&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.solid_state_q: The &6Solid State Quantum Processor&r is the first quantum circuit related component needed to make &6Quantum Processing Units&r and &6Quantum Computers&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.soyuz.title: Soyuz
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.soyuz.descrip: The &6Soyuz-FG&r is the first rocket one can make to launch &6Satellites&r into space. To launch the rocket, a &3Soyuz Launch Pad&r is needed. The pad consumes &e200kHE/s&r constantly and each launch consumes 100000mb of both &bJet Fuel&r and &bLiquid Oxygen&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.space_laborat: The &6Space Laboratory&r is a modular satellite which produces data for drives.
&2All of the Space Laboratory related satellites must have the same ID.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.supercomputer: The &3Supercomputer&r is a large computer which processes &6Flash&r and &6Disk Drives&r. Processing Drives is a very time consuming task, which can be sped up by using a more efficient coolant, at the cost of a higher recipe failure chance. Drives can also be copied, at a chance of losing both the original and the copy.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.utility_satel: These satellites are optional but very useful tools.
&3Depth Scanning Satellites&r, when linked with a &6Neutrino Lens&r armor modification applied to a helmet can be used to locate hard to detect objects, such as &6Alexandrite&r.
&3Radio Emission Satellites&r can detect high-energy events, such as nuclear explosions, particle accelerator operations and radar. Very useful for finding other people's bases.
&3Xenium Resonator Satellites&r can be used to teleport the player in the same dimension. Needs a &6Satellite Designator&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_fusion.watz_powerpla: The &3Watz&r powerplant is a fission reactor which can produce &bPoisonous Mud&r, an important component of &6CMB Steel&r. Although the reactor is not really powerful in terms of energy output, it can be stacked ontop of eachother for increased mud and power production.

If the poisonous mud buffer reaches its maximum, the reactor will melt down and explode, irradiating a wide area around it and causing fallout to fall in a small area around it. As well as this, it will spew poisonous mud in a very wide area which will then corrode any blocks that it comes in contact with, similar to corium.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.add: &3Particle Accelerators&r are either two types; linear (straight) or circular (synchronous) accelerators. Since circles do not exist in Minecraft, synchronous accelerators are square in design. They are both modular and can be built to any size, with the only restriction being resources, intended byproduct, and energy costs.

Most of the components within particle accelerators require cooling via &bCold Perfluoromethyl&r. The hot perfluoromethyl can be redirected to a &3Compressor&r for re-cooling, creating a feedback loop despite energy loss.
Particles start slowly and accelerate. Particles only do 1 component per tick, which increases by 1 every 1,000 momentum
Using a &6Screwdriver&r on a beamline toggles a window which flashes if a particle passes.
The particle accelerator requires couple &eMHEs&r to function properly. Fission reactors or fusion can be used to meet these power needs.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.ant: &bAntischrabidium&r is the gaseous antimatter equivalent of &6Schrabidium&r, typically held in cells and capsules. Much like antimatter, large quantities of antischrabidium must be stored in magnetic antimatter containment barrels.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.chi: The &6Chicken Nugget&r is the best food item in the mod, completely filling up both hunger and saturation. It is made by colliding 2 raw chickens in a Particle Accelerator. Since it is a recipe, it is the cheapest way of performing tests.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.dar: &6Dark Matter&r is made from colliding two &bAntischrabidium&r particles together. A third loop with &6BSCCO Coils&r is required.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.dig: The &6Digamma Laser Crystal&r is the fastest and final laser crystal which can be used in a SILEX.
&2If the laser touches any block, the surrounding area will be atomized.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.din: &6Dineutronium&r is the mod's (almost) ultimate material. It's a final tier material and is a higher tier than even &6Euphemium&r. It is very difficult to produce and it's used to make the most absurd and broken items this mod has. The only material that is more difficult to make, would be &6Osmiridium&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.eup: &6Euphemium&r is a fictional material which serves as one of the mod's most endgame materials. It's extremely expensive to produce in large amounts and you will need great advancement through the mod to use it effectively.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.exp: The &3Exposure Chamber&r is a machine in which many materials can be created by exposing ingots to certain particles, most important of which being &6Dineutronium&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.hig: &6Higgs Boson&r particles are created by colliding &6Lead Ions&r with &bHydrogen&r. A second loop with &6NbTi Coils&r are required. Can be also used to easily transmutate &6Uranium&r into &6Schrabidium&r in an &3Exposure Chamber&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.muo: &6Muon&r particles are created by colliding &bAntimatter&r and &bHydrogen&r. A second loop with &6NbTi Coils&r are required.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.mur: The&3 Murky Anvil&r is the ultimate version of the &3Anvil&r, having all recipes unlocked.
&6Murky Wings&r are an armor modification which grants creative flight at super fast speeds.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.par: Particle Accelerator Components
The &3Particle Accelerator&r is highly modular and as such has many parts, each serving a different function:
&3Particle Source&r: To create the particle.
&3Particle Detector&r (at a receiving end): To form the intended byproduct.
&3Quadrupole Magnets&r: To reduce particle defocus.
&3RF Cavities&r: For electromagnetic acceleration.
&3Dipole Magnets&r: For re-directing the particle.
&6Coils&r: For quadrupole and dipole magnets to function.
Particle Accelerator Looping
&2For recipes that demand high momentum, additional loops are needed. This quest serves as a guide on how to change the direction of particles.&r

Below is a miniature particle accelerator built for showcasing purposes. It is not connected to power, coolant or have any coils. It does not have rf cavities and uses two particle detectors as outputs. A compass is also provided in the image.
After constructing your PA, assuming the beamlines face the right directions, head over to the magnet that bridges the first and second loops.
Open its GUI and configure the dipole magnet.
The first line is for particles that havent reached the desired momentum.
The second line is for particles that have reached the desired momentum.
The third line is for particles that have reached the desired momentum AND are powered by redstone.
The &cRed Line&r shows the direction the particle will travel towards and the &9Blue Line&r shows where the player is facing.
Make sure that for this specific dipole magnet the third line has the particle orientation facing towards the second loop, NORTH in this case.

After this, the redstone logic must be set in order to be able to turn the particle orientation when powered. Simply provide power underneath the dipole magnet as such. A redstone signal should only exist when a particle needs momentum greater than what the first tier of coil allows.
Head over, WEST in this case, to the dipole magnet which is after the transitionary dipole and right before the detector, and which connects to the rest of the loop.
Open its GUI and configure it. Make sure the second line is facing towards the particle detector and the first line towards the other dipole magnets.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.spa: &6Sparkticle&r is made from colliding &6Strange Quark&r particles and &6Pulverized Enchantment&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.str: &6Strange Quark&r is made from colliding &6Muon&r and &6Dark Matter&r particles.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.tac: &6Tachyon&r particles are created by colliding &6Higgs Boson&r and &6Muon particles&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_particle_physics.the: The &c&r&4&r&6Digamma Particle&r is created by colliding a &6Sparkticle Capsule&r with a &6Higgs Boson Capsule&r in a &3Particle Accelerator&r. Making it in the particle accelerator will require &6Chlorophyte Coils&r and a fourth loop, at a momentum of 70,000.

The digamma particle emits a different kind of radiation, &4DRX&r, which currently can only be countered by the use of digamma medication, most notably &6Enteramine Pills&r, which provide full immunity against DRX for 10 minutes. After the &3DFC&r, Fau armor can be crafted which provides full resistance against DRX.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.balls_o_tro: Balls-O-Tron is the second boss of &dNTM&r. It can be summoned by interracting the mechanist's circle, found in the &eEnargite Temple&r which spawns in jungles, with a &6Silver Key&r, made using the Maskman Coin, or from crafting the Balls-O-Tron spawn item.
Due to the outdated nature of the bosses, aswell as the RNG needed to obtain some of the items, this quest provides an alternative way of obtaining the Balls-O-Tron coin.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.dfc.title: DFC
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.dfc.descrip: The &3DFC&r is the last reactor of the mod and as such is very expensive to craft. Apart from the DFC parts, two &6Catalysts&r are needed for the reactor to work.
The DFC core requires &e1.2THE&r of power, or &e300GHE&r with isotope boosting.
&2A Plasma Forge with a plasma input energy of 50MTU/t is required. Stellar Flux plasma is needed.&r
It is recommended that the wiki is checked out.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.dineutroniu: An upgraded version of the &3Anvil&r, [T7], which unlocks additional recipes.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.dnt_nanosui: The &6DNT Nanosuit&r is final goal of the mod. By crafting this armor you have reached the end of progression.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.fensu.title: FEnSU
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.fensu.descr: The &3FenSU&r is the ultimate energy storage block, being able to unlimited amounts of energy. It requires &e300GHE&r of power, or &e75GHE&r with isotope boosting.
&2A Plasma Forge with a plasma input energy of 50MTU/t is required. Stellar Flux plasma is needed.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.gerald_the_: &6Gerald the Construction Android&r is the most powerful weapon in the mod. Using this has the side effect of setting the world on fire but also getting tektite, which contains &6Osmiridium&r.
Gerald is the hardest recipe of the mod requiring hundreds of thousands of items, mainly circuit related.

Vast quantities of &6Bismuth&r, &6Tantalum&r and &6Silicon&r are needed, so dont hold back on bedrock ore processing and parallelisation of many processes. If you havent already used &dAE2&r, it is highly recommended at this stage of the game.

Launching Gerald will result in a global firestorm that will decimate all life, including all trees and grass. Make sure to keep a backup of your world before launching him. Gerald can also be launched in the &eNether&r or &eEnd&r.
Alternatively, the modpack introduces a &3Chemical Plant&r recipe for &6Osmiridium Infused Tektite&r to avoid the performance issues with launching gerald.
&2A Plasma Forge with a plasma input energy of 25MTU/t is required.&r &2DHC or Stellar Flux plasma is needed.&r
&2Blueprints can be found in structures, purchased from Bobmazon or made in a Precision Assembler.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.high_energy: The &3High Energy Field Jammer&r prevents schrabidium explosions from destroying blocks and damaging entities for a short while. It is a great fail-safe to have for the &3DFC&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.icf.title: ICF
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.icf.descrip: The &3ICF&r reactor is a very expensive and powerful reactor, which can produce a substantial amount of energy. Apart from the multiblock itself, &3ICF Lasers&r must be constructed for the reactor to work. &bStellar Flux&r will be produced during its operation which is needed to craft &6Gerald&r. Consider making use of &bLiquid Lead&r as it is a very efficient coolant for the ICF.
&2A Plasma Forge with a plasma input energy of 1MTU/t is required.&r
It is recommended that the wiki is checked out as it has built-in calculators for the laser power consumption and the amount of hot coolant it produces.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.icf_fuels.d: The &3ICF&r can process different combinations of fuels at different laser power levels. A cheap and renewable fuel that can be used to gather the &bStellar Flux&r needed for &6Gerald&r and make decent power is &bHelium-4 - Hydrogen&r.
Applying a Muon Particle to a fuel pellet will decrease the power that is needed to run it.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.icf_laser.d: &2This quest provides an optional retrieval task for two small lasers capable of running Helium-4 - Deuterium Fuel at 15MHE, producing up to 537 MHE/s.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.icf_laser_t: The &3ICF Laser Turbocharger&r can be placed next to &3ICF Laser Capacitors&r to increase the laser's power by a substantial amount, allowing for the &3ICF&r to run higher grade fuels.
&6Osmiridium&r is the second most expensive material and is used primarely in the &3DFC&r.
The ratio is 9 Osmiridium-Infused Tektite to one ingot.
&2Installing an effectiveness upgrade on the ore acidizer is recommended.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.quantum_com: The &6Quantum Computer&r is the most powerful out of any other control unit. It  used to build &6Gerald&r and the &3DFC&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.spark_laser: The &6Spark Laser Crystal&r unlocks new recipes, most importantly it is used to create &6Osmiridium&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.spark_singu: The &6Spark Singularity&r is a singularity made from combining all the types of singularities with &6Dineutronium&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.the_book_of: The &6Book of Boxcars&r is an item which allows the crafting of many special items. The book can be found inside &eMeteorite Dungeons&r found randomly in the wilderness, indicated by either skulls on the ground of a black pillar, or in &eRed Rooms&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.ufo_coin.de: The Martian Invasion Ship is a late-game boss which is killed to get the &6UFO Coin&r, used in crafting Gerald.
This quest provides an alternative way of obtaining the coin.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.welded_osmi: &6Welded Osmiridium Plates&r cost 300 Billion &eHE&r to produce, so good energy generation and storage infrastructure is needed.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_end_game.yharonite_b: The &6Yharonite Billet&r is created in a tungsten crate that has &6Polonium Billets&r in it while being shot from a &3DFC Emitter&r with a minumum of 10 &eMSpk&r of DFC energy. This can be checked by opening the GUI of the receiver while it is not blocked by the crate and the reactor is operating.
This is the final material obtained in the mod.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.autocal_au: The &3AUTOCAL Automatic Calculator&r is a basic machine that reads a script, line by line, and performs actions based on those lines. This means it can be programmed with behavior, doing math, and handling signals. It communicates with the outside world exclusively using ROR signals, allowing RoR to supply it with values to be processed, and returning RoR signals to be displayed or for controlling RoR receiving devices.
&2A documentation button exists inside the machine for people that want to learn how to use it.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.automatic_: The &3Automatic Crafting Table&r is able to perform crafts when supplied with power and a blueprint inside of it is set. The Blueprint is located at the blue crafting area and the items can be defined by using either items inside the player's inventory or by dragging them fron the NEI menu.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.combinator: The Combinator Funnel is used to perform crafts of the same item in a 3x3 or 2x2 grid. It becomes extremely useful for &eBedrock Ore Processing&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.conveyor_b: &3Conveyor Boxers&r package a certain amount of items into a box, configurable inside a &3Conveyor Boxer&r, and output them as a single item on a conveyor belt. They are then unpackaged at the &3Conveyor Unboxer&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.conveyor_g: The &3Conveyor Grabber&r grabs items straight off of the conveyor belt without having the line go into it. It does not have an internal buffer.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.conveyor_s:
&3Conveyor Sorters&r are blocks that can sort various items to a specific conveyor belt. They do not have a buffer and simply move items to connected conveyor belts based on their filter options, therefore they can sort items as quickly as they receive them.
The sorter has six outputs with five slots each, making it able to route multiple items to one belt.
The &3Conveyor Splitter&r is a type of conveyor belt that splits items evenly onto 2 lanes. The ratio is 1:1, but can be configured using a &6Screwdriver&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.conveyor_u: Conveyors blocks can be equiped with two different types of upgrades.
&6Stack Ejection&r, which outputs more items at once.
&6Speed Ejection&r, which outputs items at a faster rate.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.gauges.des: &3Gauges&r are used to measure the amount of energy or fluid passing through the network.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.multi_lane: Multi-Lane Conveyor Belts can be used to transport items on different lanes on the same block.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.network_se: The &3Network Separator&r can be used to split up a power network into multiple. It has a power gauge integrated into it and can be shut off by providing power from beneath.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.redstone_o: &dNTM&r introduces &eRedstone-Over Radio&r, which is a system of sending redstone signals wirelessly. There are many ROR components which serve different purposes, from maintaining a certain amount of fluid in a tank to reading item amounts in containers.

The foundational components of this system are the ROR &6Transmitter&r and &6Receiver&r. As their name suggests, they can send and receive redstone signals. For them to be linked together, both need the same &eID&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.ror_arc_fu: &2This quest serves as a guide on how to precisely input items in an arc furnace as not to waste electrode durability.&r

Assuming no upgrades are inserted in the &3Arc Furnace&r, there are exactly 20 slots available for items. To start, route all input items into a &3Conveyor Boxer&r which will send items into a &3Conveyor Unboxer&r. Adding speed ejection and stack ejection upgrades to the unboxer is highly recommended as so the items are inputed fast enough.
Place a &3Redstone-Over-Radio Item Counter&r on one side of the boxer, set the item filter and give it an ID.
Then place a Redstone-Over-Radio Logic Receiver, give it the correct ID, and set it to emit redstone when item count is 20.
Make sure that the boxer has its mode set to redstone.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.ror_displa: ROR &3Panels&r can be used to craft useful ROR components such as Gauges, Switches, Graphs and more. Shift-Click with a screwdriver to configure them once placed.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.ror_fluid_: Redstone-Over Radio&r in combination with a &3Redstone Fluid Valve&r can be used to detect when a tank is starting to fill up, and release the insides. This is useful for having buffers without having all the fluids being wasted.
&2Here is an exmaple of a tank that will only output fluid once its full:&r
Firstly, place a &6ROR Transmitter&r on one port of the tank, provide an ID and enable Polling.
After that, place a &6ROR Logic Receiver&r next to the fluid valve and input the desired settings. Make sure that your signal is >= of your desired buffer. One redstone level equals to 16k mb.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.ror_item_c: The ROR &6Item Counter&r is used to count the amount of items inside a container. It can transmit up to 3 signals, the items of which need to be specified with filters.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.ror_logic_: The ROR &6Logic Receiver&r is a more advanced version of the receiver with a more extensive UI which can be used to specify the conditions that are needed for a signal to be received.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_logistics.telex_mach: The &3Telex Machine&r is used to send signals to other Telex Machines. It can also send signals if it receives a message and can print out messages on a piece of paper.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.bedrock: Some steps will produce crumbs which can be further processed into more primary outputs in an arc furnace or electrolyzer, or combined into a full stack of 64 and washed with &bOre Slop&r to produce more unprocessed ore, which can be passed back into the system to yield even more ores.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.centrif: All ores must be processed in a &3Centrifuge&r in order to extract products from them. The first stage of centrifuging will produce a second stage of ore which can either be centrifuged again to immediately get primary products and finish processing, or can be washed with solvents to acquire useful byproducts.
Gravel obtained from centrifuging can be processed into concrete for base building, in a &3SILEX&r for additional byproducts, such as &6Lithium&r and &6Boron&r, or shredded into sand for &6Silicon&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.cleaned: There are multiple ways of processing at this stage, most efficient being the &3Arc Furnace&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.dissolv: There are multiple ways of processing at this stage, most efficient being the &3Arc Furnace&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.ore_slo: &bOre Slop&r&r can be processed most efficiently in an &3Electrolysis Machine&r, giving &6Mercury&r, &6Niter&r, &6Sulfur&r and &6Limestone&r. Products obtained from the processing can be used to make acids for the rest of the bedrock ore plant.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.primary: There are multiple ways of processing at this stage, most efficient being the &3Electrolysis Machine&r.
Increase primary or secondary products with &bHydrogen&r or &bChlorine Gas&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.raw_bed: The first step to processing &eRaw Bedrock Ore&r straight out of the ground is to run it through a &3Bedrock Ore Processor&r. This will split the raw ore into general types, with amounts depending on the location the ore was extracted and any effectiveness upgrades. These types are:
&eRare Earth&r - rare earth metals including &6Cobalt/Rare Earth&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.roasted: Most ore processing stages can be passed through a &3Combination Oven&r or a &3Pyrolysis Oven&r to produce &bVitriol&r. The ore itself will not be affected by this process - yielding the same outputs whether or not the ore is roasted - so this can be done to add bonus byproducts (from processing the vitriol) effectively for free.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.second_: Centrifuge your Solvent Washed Bedrock ores to seperate primary and secondary products.
&2The following quests will assume that High-Performance Solvent is used.
Roast your bedrock ore again for additional &bVitriol&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.solvent: After the first centrifuging stage, ores can be washed with various fluids to increase primary products or add byproducts, these include:
&s&bSulfuric Acid&r - adds the first tier of byproducts to your outputs
&bSolvent&r - adds the second tier of byproducts
&bHigh-Performance Solvent&r - adds the final tier of byproducts
&bLiquid Hydrogen&r - increases the yield of the first primary product
&bChlorine Gas&r - increases the yield of the second primary product

&2Note that processing with higher tier solvents will produce lower tier products as well, meaning processing with HPS will provide all available byproducts. Ores processed with lower tier solvents can be processed again with higher tiers to further increase yields, doubling outputs each time!
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.sulfuri: There are multiple ways of processing at this stage, most efficient being the &3Arc Furnace&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.vitriol: &bVitriol&r is the best way to obtain &bChlorine Gas&r from processing it in an &3Electrolysis Machine&r, with additional byproducts of &bSulfuric Acid&r and &bIron&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_bedrock_ores.water_w: Ores can be washed to increase the number of primary products and even add useful additional byproducts. Washing is done in &3Ore Acidizers&r with different fluids.
Ores straight out of the &3Bedrock Ore Processor&r (before initial centrifuging) can be washed with &bWater&r to immediately duplicate all products, making it a very desirable first step.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.acceleration_car: The &6Acceleration Card&r increases the speed of various AE2 devices.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.ae2_autocrafting: &2This quest serves an a guide on how to order items using the ME system. The example item will be an Analog Circuit.&r

With an &3ME Drive&r providing item storage, a &3Crafting CPU&r and &3Interfaces&r, one can request any item to be crafted. The image below makes use of a &3Molecular Assembler&r, a &3Soldering Station&r, an &3Electric Press&r aswell as two &3Import Buses&r which serve as an output for the solderer and press.

The first step in automating crafting recipes is to encode &6ME Patterns&r. There are two types of patterns, crafting and processing. The crafting pattern is created by having the &3Pattern Terminal&r set to the crafting table. After placing the items in the terminal, press the arrow to finish encoding the recipe.
For recipes which arent made in a crafting table, such as the &6Wires&r and the &6Analog Circuit&r itself, the pattern terminal needs to be switched to the processing mode, which has a furnace icon.

After all the patterns have been created, insert them into their respective interfaces.
Make sure to enable blocking mode on the interfaces as not to have multiple different recipes enter the interface at once.
Finally, after everything has been set up, the option to order items will be shown in the ME terminal.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.ae2_changes.desc: In this modpack, &dApplied Energistics 2&r has been changed to fit in more with &dNTM&r. Many components have been changed to include NTM materials and some machines, like the &3Grinder&r and &3Inscriber&r, have had their functions moved to the &3Shredder&r and &3Press&r. The meteors have also been removed, but &6Skystone&r can still be crafted for building purposes.
This Chapter of the quests has its information derived from the FTB Wiki. If anything else is missing from the quest book, please visit the wiki.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.cable_fluix.desc: The &6ME Glass Cable - Fluix&r is a cable used to transmit data and energy between devices in an ME Network. It is capable of transmitting &f&e8 channels&r simultaneously.
The &6Quartz Fiber&r is used to transfer energy, but not channels.
&6Cable Anchors&r can be used to seperate ME cable connections. They can also be used to make &6Facades&r for the cables.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.cell_workbench.d: The &3Cell Workbench&r allow to filter cells to accept specific items. It can prove useful for when making a subnet for &eBedrock Ore Processing&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.certus_quartz_cr: &6Certus Quartz&r is an important material in AE2. It is dropped when mining or processing certus quartz ore at the rate of one to four, the yield is affected by a tool's Fortune enchantment. Certus Quartz is often interchangeable with vanilla &6Nether Quartz&r in the recipes for basic tools, such as the &6Quartz Cutting Knife&r. Certus quartz ore can be acidized or centrifuged for an increased yield.
&2Certus quartz can later be made in a Chemical Plant using nether quartz.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.charger.title: Charger
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.charger.descript: The &3Charger&r is a machine which will charge &6Certus Quartz Crystals&r into their charged form at the expense of power.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.crafting_cpu.des: The Crafting CPU is a multiblock structure composed of &3Crafting Co-Processing Units&r and &3Crafting Storage&r. When placed next to eachother they form one CPU which is used when placing orders via &3Interfaces&r. The more crafting co-processing units the more tasks the CPU can do in parallel while more crafting storage allows for bigger orders to be made.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.crystal_growth_a: The &3Crystal Growth Accelerator&r is a machine that uses energy to accelerate the process of crystal purification. This process transforms crystal seeds into pure versions of their fully developed counterparts.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.crystal_growth_c: The&3 Crystal Growth Chamber&r is a machine in which crystals can grow at an increased speed, while also being in a block instead of being dropped in the ground.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.dense_fluix_cabl: The &6Dense ME Fluix Cables&r can be used to transmit &e32 channels&r from an &3ME Controller&r.
One controller is capable of connecting up to 6 dense cables, in turn each can branch off to 4 smaller cable lines connecting up to 192 ME devices to the network.
The &6Smart Dense Cable&r also displays the amount of channels that are been used, but is known to be less performance friendly than the dense covered cables.

In addition there are 16 colored cables made with the appropriate dye. The colored cables allow contact with other cables without sharing the signal or connecting to any other cable but the ones of the same colour.
The &3Energy Acceptor&r transfers energy into the ME system. In combination with an &3HE to RF Converter&r, the ME system can be powered.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.energy_cell.desc: The &3Energy Cell&r acts as a battery for the ME network. It becomes useful when the ME system begins to consume large amounts of energy, so a buffer is needed so it doesnt turn on and off constantly.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.fluix_crystal.de: &6Fluix Crystals&r are another crystal type which is used in crafting recipes throughout the mod. The crystal comes in two forms, the regular fluix crystal and the &6Pure Fluix Crystal&r.
To create a fluix crystal, 1&6 Charged Certus Quartz&r, 1 &6Nether Quartz&r, and 1 &6Redstone Dust&r must be dropped into a pool of &bWater&r. They will be consumed and output 2 fluix crystals.
&2Fluix crystals can later be made in a Chemical Plant using charged certus quartz and redstone.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.infinity_booster: The &6Infinity Booster Card&r allows one to access their ME system across any distance and dimension. To apply simply open the &6Wireless Crafting Terminal&r and insert the card in it.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_buses.title: ME Buses
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_buses.descrip: The &3ME Export Bus&r is an ME component which is used to export items from the ME network into a machine or other input inventory.
The &3ME Import Bus&r is an ME component which is used to import items directly into the ME Network from a machine or other output inventory.
&2It is recommended that Interfaces are used over Export/Import buses for performance reasons.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_controller.de: The &3ME Controller&r acts as the routing hub of an ME network. It has the ability to transmit data throughout the ME Network using &e32 channels&r per side. The &6ME Dense Cable&r is the only cable that can support 32 channel simultaneously so it can be used as a main data line to connect to another ME Controller or branch off into 8 channel distribution lines via &6ME Glass Cable&r, &6ME Covered Cable&r (less lag)&r or &6ME Smart Cable&r (displays the amount of channels used) to connect all the devices and multi-block structures in the network.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_drive.title: ME Drive
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_drive.descrip: The &3ME Drive&r serves as the storage of the ME system, in which &6Storage Cells&r can be put and store items.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_interface.des: The &3ME Interface&r is a block which allows the ME Network to interact with machines and inventories. On their own, they can be used to automatically stock inventories, but can be used with &6ME Patterns&r later on for autocrafting.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_io_port.title: ME IO Port
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_io_port.descr: The &3ME IO Port&r can transfer the contents of storage cells into an ME Network and back.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_pattern.title: ME Pattern
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_pattern.descr: &6ME Patterns&r are used to encode recipes to be used in &3Interfaces&r. They can be encoded in a &3Pattern Terminal&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_storage_bus.d: The &3ME Storage Bus&r, when attached to an block/tile entity with an inventory (generally a storage unit, such as chests or a &3Drawer Controller&r), will include that inventory's contents in the ME System.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_storage_reshu: The &3ME Storage Reshuffle&r organises the items in your ME Storage Cells, reducing item type uses by combining them to save up space.
<c value=#ff5555>Disconnect Storage Buses or else the system will pull them in and deposit them in Storage Cells.</c>
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_subnetting.de: &eSubnetworks&r are ME networks which can be accessed from a &eMain Network&r. In &dNTM&r&r they can be useful for storing items from passive processes without flooding the main storage network.
&2This quest serves as a guide on how to set up a subnet, which can be used to store the resources that Bedrock Ore Processing produces.&r
In the image below are two ME networks, the &cRed&r one as the &cMainnet&r, and the &9Blue&r one as the &9Subnet&r.
For the purposes of this quest, the main network will store dirt blocks, while the subnet will store copper blocks.
To make the contents of the subnet, the copper blocks, visible to the main net, one must make an &3Interface&r-&3Storage Bus&r&r combo. The storage bus must be on the side of the main network.
Make sure to filter the main network storage bus, and to also make it "Extract Only".
Now the main network has access to materials stored on the sub network, which can be used for crafting.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.me_terminal.desc: The &3ME Terminal&r is used to access all available items in the ME Network, including craftable ones.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.modifier_cards.d: &6Modifier Cards&r allow for modification to various ME components, such as speeding them up or being able to toggle them on and off using redstone.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.molecular_assemb: The &3Molecular Assembler&r is used to autocraft anything that can be made in a crafting table.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.network_tool.des: The &6Network Tool&r, when right-clicking on any network device will bring up the tool's interface showing all devices connected to the network as well as network details. As any wrench, shift clicking on a cable will remove it.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.network_visualis: The &6Network Visualisation Tool&r is used to visuallize an ME Network by right-clicking on any of its blocks, making it very useful when making a large network, especially one that uses &3P2P&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.overflow_void_ca: The &6Overflow Void Card&r acts as a voiding upgrade for AE2 &6Storage Cells&r. It can be added to a storage cell using the &3Cell Workbench&r.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.p2p.title: P2P
&6P2P&r Tunnel or "Point to Point Tunnels" are a versatile configurable system to move items / redstone / power / and fluids from one location to another though an existing ME Network without storage.
Tunnels are &e1 input to N outputs&r. This means you can output to as many points as you want, but only input at a single point per tunnel.
Networks can support any number of tunnels, of any different types, and they all function independently.

ME tunnels can be used to carry channels from one location to another, and can carry up to &e32 channels&r, same as a &6ME Dense Cable&r, while only requiring a single channel per point, making tunnels a very powerful tool to expand me networks, especially over a distance. However with the great flex-ability they give you comes a limitation, the channel of a p2p tunnel cannot be carried by another p2p tunnel, meaning that you cannot nest them recursively.

To configure a P2P tunnel you must first attune the tunnel to carry what you want it to, then you need to configure the outputs to their input. You configure the connections by using the &6Memory Card&r. First Shift+Right Click the input to save it on your memory card, then simply right click the different outputs to store the input onto the outputs. this also sets the type of the output to match the type of the input.
&2An advanced version of the Memory Card can also be made, which interacts with the entire network.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.p2p_interface.de: The &3P2P Interface&r is a P2P device which can be used to easily paralellize recipes across many machines.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.p2p_interface_pa: Parallelisation of processes can significantly cut down on waiting time and as such it is highly recommended that P2P Interfaces are used.
&2This quest serves as a guide on how to use P2P Interfaces.&r
As any P2P Connection goes, there needs to be one input, which in this case, holds the &6ME Patterns&r.
After patterns are inserted in the first P2P interface, place down the rest of the output interfaces you want and link them together using a &6Memory Card&r.
In the image below, the P2P interface highlighted in green stores the patterns, while the ones in blue, are the output ones which will connect machines to the ME system.
Make sure to have blocking mode enabled on all output P2P interfaces as to prevent clogging and having multiple recipes trying to be executed at once in the same machine.
<c value=#ff5555>Blocking mode will not work in the Presses as it counts the mold as an item.</c>
Finally, place your desired machines at the output P2P interfaces and add a way of retrieving the items once the operation is done, in this case import buses.
It is recommended that conveyors are used to insert into interfaces to save up on channels.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.p2p_me_networkin: &3P2P ME&r can be used to transport massive amounts of channels without laying many cables.
&2This quest serves as a guide on how to effectively use P2P ME.&r

Once an &3Energy Acceptor&r has been set up, it is highly recommended (and likely needed) that an &3Energy Cell&r is placed next to it as to ensure that there is enough power going to the system, as more components increase the energy demands of the ME system.

After that, 2 &3ME Controllers&r are required, one to provide the channels that machines will use, and another to transport the other's channels by the P2P connections. The top controller can be made bigger by attaching more controllers next to it.

After the controllers are placed, on the top controller, a P2P Tunnel - ME needs to be placed on any side. The &9Blue Cable&r will serve as the cable that connects the P2P connections, and as such, it needs to be connected to the bottom controller.

By linking the P2P connections together using a &6Memory Card&r, the 32 channels from one side of the top controller will only use 1 channel from the bottom controller to be transported to any destination. The &cRed Cable&r now has access to 32 channels.
By expanding on the previous example, more connections can be added to fully utilize all channels.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.pattern_capacity: The &6Pattern Capacity Card&r can be used to add 9 more slots for patterns in an &3ME Interface&r. Up to 3 cards can be inserted.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.quantum_network_: A &3Quantum Network Bridge&r is a multiblock structure that connects 2 potentially distant, or even in different dimensions, network fragments together. Created by crafting 8 &3ME Quantum Ring&r and a &3ME Quantum Link Chamber&r and placing the ME quantum link chamber in the center, and sourrounding it in the 8 ME quantum rings.

Each quantum network bridge requires power to function. This power must be provided from the network fragment it is attached to until the bridge is linked; at which time power from either side will be available. However if power is lost, connectivity will fail and power will be drained from the side the bridge is on in attempt to restore connection.

To establish a link between 2 quantum network bridges, you must create a pair of &6Quantum Entangled Singularities&r. One of each will be placed inside of a particular connection. Each Bridge may only connect to one other bridge.

AE2 Singularities are created by dumping 256k of any block inside a &3Matter Condenser&r. Singularities can become quantum entangled by dropping a singularity and ender dust and then exploding them together.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.security_termina: The &3Security Terminal&r can be used to specify what players are allowed to interact with in the ME network which can be useful in multiplayer.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.spatial_io.title: Spatial IO
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.spatial_io.descr: &3Spatial IO&r is a way to cut-and-paste physical volumes of space in your world. It works by swapping the defined volume with an identically-sized volume in the spatial storage dimension, sending whatever's in the pylon array to the spatial storage dimension, and whatever's in the dimension to the pylon array.

Spatial IO requires a specific arrangement of its components in order to function, and define the volume to be cut-and-pasted. All of the components must be on the same network in order to function, and you can have only one spatial IO setup on a network. Thus, a subnetwork is recommended.
The &3Spatial IO Port&r controls the spatial IO operation. It shows stats on the multiblock setup, and holds the spatial cells

To perform a spatial IO operation, place a &6Spatial Storage Cell&r in the input slot and give the spatial IO port a redstone pulse. It will then swap the volume in the pylons with the volume in the spatial storage dimension. This means that if you send some set of blocks to the spatial storage dimension, then put another set of blocks in the pylons, put the cell back in the input slot, and trigger the IO port again, the 2nd set of blocks will disappear and the 1st set of blcks will reappear.
Any entity in the defined volume, including you, will be carried along, and if you have no way of getting out, you will be trapped in the spatial storage dimension.

&3Spatial Pylons&r are the main part of a spatial IO setup, and define the volume to be affected. The volume is defined by the bounding box of the outside of the pylons, contracted in by 1 block in all directions.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.storage_componen: The &6ME Storage Housing&r is the outer shell of a &6Storage Cell&r. There are many tiers of storage cells, all of which require the use of NTM machines to be crafted.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.void_me_storage_: The &6Void ME Storage Cell&r, when filtered, will void all of that specific item that enters the ME system.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.wireless_connect: &3Wireless Connectors&r allow for channel linking without ME cables, making it possible to send channels through walls. The further away the connectors are the more energy consuming they become.
A &3Wireless Hub&r can be used to link channels between multiple wireless connectors.
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.wireless_craftin: An upgraded version of the &6Wireless Terminal&r, capable of crafting items on the go.
&2The wireless crafting terminal can be added to a bauble slot and used without it being in the inventory. Make sure to set the keybind in the controls menu.&r
eqpack.quest.oq_ntm_ae2.wireless_termina: The ME network can be accessed Wirelessly using a &6Wireless Terminal&r. To link the device to the network right-click with it on a &3Wireless Access Point&r. At least one is required, and its range can be expanded using &6Wireless Boosters&r. The starting range is 16 blocks from the booster, but it can go up to 528 blocks using 64 booster cards.
